About Crystal Steel Fabricators, Inc.
-------------------------------------

Founded in 1992, Crystal Steel Fabricators, Inc. has grown from a single site in Delmar, DE to five global locations. An AISC Certified Fabricator for over 15 years, we now carry Fracture Critical, Bridge Component Standard and Sophisticated Paint Endorsements in addition to Steel Building Structures certification. Crystal Steel serves the largest and most sophisticated clients in the industry, delivering steel to job sites up and down the East Coast on time and as promised to keep your critical path on track.  
  
Our fabrication is coordinated across our plants in Delmar, DE; Hatfield, PA; Memphis, TN; Federalsburg, MD; and Manila, The Philippines, offering a combined 260,000 sq. ft. of fabrication and design space and 350 staff. Crystal Steel is a certified MBE in multiple jurisdictions, giving your jobs not only quality steel delivered on time, but a competitive edge in bidding work. We have won numerous awards for our performance on large and small jobs and carry unlimited bonding capacity.  
  
Our Delmar shop has people working round the clock to make sure your job is managed, fabricated and delivered on time. Crystal Metalworks, Inc., our award-winning Miscellaneous and Ornamental Metals division based in Hatfield, PA, provides a complete solution for the steel package on your job. Our shop in Memphis, TN provides both Structural and Miscellaneous Metals to jobs throughout the Southeastern United States with the same level of quality that made Crystal Steel the go-to fabricator in the Mid-Atlantic. Our Manila office gives us one of the largest in-house detailing organizations in the industry, producing shop drawings for the most difficult jobs and allowing us to meet the most demanding schedules.  
  
Using virtually all industry-standard as well as cutting edge technology, Crystal Steel has been at the forefront of the digital revolution in the construction industry, always finding new ways to collaborate to shorten the time from contract to delivery.

About Instituto Politécnico de Viana do Castelo
-----------------------------------------------

O IPVC e a Região  
  
Criado em 1980 por Decreto-Lei 303/80 de 16 de Agosto, o Instituto Politécnico de Viana do Castelo \[IPVC\] encontra-se inserido no Alto Minho, território em que a ocupação e as atividades humanas se desenvolvem numa tradição de valorização dos recursos naturais. O IPVC tem como objetivo prosseguir, através das suas Escolas Superiores, a formação humana, cultural, científica, técnica e profissional de qualidade, realizar a investigação necessária e adequada à prossecução da sua missão e cooperar com a comunidade regional, particularmente no seu tecido produtivo e empresarial, numa perspetiva de permanente diálogo e valorização recíproca.  
  
Oferta Formativa  
  
Na rede do Ensino Superior do Alto Minho, o Instituto Politécnico de Viana do Castelo é a entidade que dispõe de maior oferta formativa.  
Para além de Cursos Técnicos Superiores Profissionais \[CTeSP\], ministra cursos superiores, entre os quais, Licenciaturas, Pós-Graduações e Mestrados (vários em cooperação com universidades estrangeiras e nacionais), através das seis Escolas Superiores que integra:  
  
Escola Superior de Educação (Viana do Castelo)  
Escola Superior Agrária (Ponte de Lima)  
Escola Superior de Tecnologia e Gestão (Viana do Castelo)

For over 30 years, we at CMS Belgium have been advising local and international businesses operating in Belgium and, since 1 January 2010, Luxembourg.  
  
Clients appreciate our entrepreneurial and team spirit as well as the strong relationships we build with them. Our lawyers are genuine experts in their fields, with a grasp of detail that is second to none. That depth of knowledge gives them the ability to anticipate challenges – and their collective experience gives them the ability to meet these challenges in innovative and sector-shaping ways.  
  
We are a full-service law firm with more than 130 lawyers, including 27 partners, operating from offices in Brussels, Antwerp and Luxembourg. Our Belgian firm is a founding member of CMS.  
  
Founded in 1999, CMS is a full-service top 10 global law firm, based on the number of lawyers (Am Law 2012 Global 100). With more than 70 offices in over 40 countries across the world, employing more than 4,500 lawyers, CMS is one of the most global law firms in the AmLaw Global Top 100. CMS acts for a large number of Fortune 500 companies and the FT European 500 and for the majority of the DAX 30. Revenues totalled EUR 1.426bn in 2019. CMS provides a wide range of expertise across 19 expert practice and sector areas including Corporate, Energy, Lifesciences/Pharmaceuticals, TMC, Tax, Banking and Finance, Commercial, Competition, Dispute Resolution, Employment, Intellectual Property and Real Estate & Construction.

About Trevor Haynes

Trevor Haynes, a retired CEO and seasoned professional with a wealth of experience in project management, construction management, and sustainable development, has seamlessly transitioned into a fulfilling role as a Church Bell Ringer. As the Tower Captain and Steeple Keeper at Thaxted Parish Church, Trevor not only oversees the intricate art of bell ringing but also ensures the safety and maintenance of the bell tower, leveraging his expertise as a Health & Safety Officer. His commitment to the community is evident in his active participation in ringing for services, weddings, funerals, and other significant events, fostering a sense of tradition and connection among parishioners.  
  
With a background as a Chartered Manager and Chartered Surveyor (FRICS), Trevor brings a unique perspective to his role in the church. His skills in facilities management and procurement are invaluable as he collaborates with the Parochial Church Council (PCC) and the Estates Committee to enhance the church's infrastructure while promoting sustainability. Trevor's qualifications from the Association of Ringing Teachers (ART) enable him to teach bell handling, ensuring that the next generation of ringers is well-equipped to carry on this cherished tradition.  
  
Beyond his responsibilities at the church, Trevor is passionate about the outdoors and environmental sustainability, often engaging in activities that promote awareness and conservation. His multifaceted background and dedication to community service make him a respected figure in both the bell ringing community and the broader local landscape. As he continues to learn and grow in this new chapter of his life, Trevor exemplifies how retirement can be a time for enriching experiences and meaningful contributions.

About BVE - Brasil Vagas Executivas

O BVE nasceu em 2008 como um grupo de profissionais no LinkedIn e com a missão de unir quem seleciona com quem busca novas oportunidades no mercado de mercado.  
  
Em outubro/2010, com o crescimento do grupo, nasce a empresa BVE - BRASIL VAGAS EXECUTIVAS com o objetivo de oferecer ao mercado prestação de serviços na área de Recursos Humanos e assim, proporcionar um melhor resultado para profissionais e empresas.  
  
ATRAÇÃO E SELEÇÃO DE PROFISSIONAIS  
O BVE tem a atração como seu ponto mais forte. Somos, antes de tudo, um grupo de profissionais altamente qualificados e que coincide com a necessidade da mudança. Esse princípio, além de ser um diferencial exclusivo, tem como consequência um processo seletivo de alto nível, com avaliação PI e testes de acordo com a necessidade estipulada pelo cliente.  
  
APOIO AO PROFISSIONAL EM TRANSIÇÃO DE CARREIRA  
O BVE vem se especializando, também, em apoiar o profissional em transição de carreira seja através de ações presenciais ou através de recursos tecnológicos atuais. Da mesma forma que a identificação digital, um profissional encara o momento da transição de carreira de maneira única e tem reações completamente diferente de outro profissional. Nossa metodologia alinha o comportamento racional ao comportamento emocional analisando e confrontando cenários atuais e futuros.  
  
O BVE também atua no segmento de Cursos e Treinamentos sempre voltados em manter e aumentar a empregabilidade dos profissionais.

What age groups does Chicago KICS United FC cater to?

Chicago KICS United FC offers programs for a wide range of age groups, starting from as young as 3 years old up to 18 years old. Our youth soccer education programs are designed to foster skill development and a love for the game at every stage of a child's growth.

What types of soccer programs are available at Chicago KICS United FC?

We provide a variety of soccer programs, including recreational leagues, competitive travel teams, and specialized training sessions. Our offerings also include skill development clinics, summer camps, and seasonal leagues, ensuring that players of all skill levels find a suitable program to enhance their abilities.

How does Chicago KICS United FC support player development?

At Chicago KICS United FC, we emphasize a holistic approach to player development. Our experienced coaches focus on technical skills, tactical understanding, physical fitness, and mental resilience. We also provide opportunities for players to participate in competitive environments, helping them to grow and excel both on and off the field.

Are there opportunities for parents to get involved with the club?

Absolutely! We encourage parental involvement through various volunteer opportunities, coaching clinics, and support roles within the club. Parents can also participate in fundraising events and community outreach programs, helping to create a strong, supportive environment for our young athletes.

What is the club's approach to child enrichment and education?

Chicago KICS United FC believes in the importance of child enrichment beyond just soccer skills. We integrate life skills training, teamwork, and leadership development into our programs. Our goal is to empower players not only as athletes but also as responsible and confident individuals in their communities.

How can I register my child for a program at Chicago KICS United FC?

About The National Child Protection Task Force
----------------------------------------------

The National Child Protection Task Force, a registered 501c3, was founded to provide law enforcement access to investigative expertise and resources that are unavailable or under-funded in most law enforcement organizations. The members of our Task Force volunteer their time to any agency -- small or large, international or local -- on important, time-sensitive cases involving not only human trafficking, child exploitation, and missing persons cases, but also property, homicide, drugs, and terrorism cases.  
  
  
  
We come from all walks of life and professional backgrounds, but we are united in our belief that we have a responsibility to make society a better place for everyone, especially our most vulnerable members.

About Escola Americana De Campinas
----------------------------------

EAC an independent, non-profit, co-educational day school that serves students ages 2-19. EAC holds accreditation from the Council of International Schools (London, UK) and the New England Association of Schools and Colleges (Boston, USA). Pre-School students experience the Montessori Program in the Pre-School, a complementary standards-based American program and Brazilian program in the Elementary School and Upper School (Grades 1-12), and the International Baccalaureate Diploma Program in Grades 11-12.  
  
EAC is a close-knit school community that possesses a compelling vision and mission that calls for a commitment to…be a community of globally minded and life long learners reaching our fullest potential… More specifically, we strive to help our students develop into GIANTS.  
  
G- Globally Minded  
  
I- Innovative Thinkers and Learners  
  
A- Accountable Risk-Takers  
  
N- Nurtures Passions  
  
T- Thoughtful and Reflective  
  
S- Strives for Success  
  
A talented multinational faculty supported by a committed administration strives to realize this vision by challenging students intellectually and supporting their physical, social, and emotional wellbeing.  
  
Working in partnership with parents, EAC supports students to develop their talents and pursue their interests and passions within EAC’s four pillars- academics, arts, athletics, and global citizenship. Tomorrow's diplomatic, business, educational, and scientific leaders are enrolled in our school today.  
  
EAC is a school very much on the move. Committed to continuous improvement, EAC is in process of developing an adaptive strategic plan that will serve as a blueprint for present and future developments in the areas 21st century educational programs, teaching and learning, human resources, finance and facilities, and community building. Our mandate is to respond to a rapidly changing world with thoughtful and innovative actions to ensure every student achieves his/her personal and academic potential.

About Nancy Pelosy

Nancy Pelosi is a prominent American politician who has spent over three decades serving as a United States Representative for California's 12th congressional district. Born and raised in Baltimore, Maryland, Pelosi's interest in politics was sparked at an early age by her family's involvement in local Democratic politics. After graduating from Trinity College in Washington, D.C., she moved to California and quickly became active in the Democratic Party, serving as the chair of the California Democratic Party and later as a member of the Democratic National Committee.  
  
Pelosi's political career took a significant turn in 1987 when she was elected as the U.S. Representative for California's 5th congressional district. Over the years, she has become known for her progressive values and strong advocacy for issues such as healthcare, women's rights, and gun control. In 2002, Pelosi made history by becoming the first woman to lead a major party in Congress when she was elected as the House Minority Leader. Four years later, she made history once again by being elected as the first woman to serve as Speaker of the House, a position she held from 2007 to 2011 and then again from 2019 to the present.  
  
Throughout her tenure in Congress, Pelosi has been a powerful and influential figure, leading the charge on numerous pieces of legislation and playing a key role in shaping the Democratic Party's agenda. She has been a vocal critic of the Trump administration, using her position as Speaker to challenge the president's policies and actions. Pelosi's unwavering dedication to her constituents and her commitment to promoting the values of the Democratic Party have earned her widespread respect and admiration from her colleagues as well as from the American public.  
  
As Speaker of the House, Pelosi has been at the forefront of the Democratic Party's efforts to enact important legislation on issues such as healthcare, immigration, and climate change. She played a crucial role in the passage of the Affordable Care Act in 2010, marking a significant milestone in the fight for universal healthcare coverage in the United States. Pelosi has also been a staunch advocate for comprehensive immigration reform, pushing for legislation that would provide a pathway to citizenship for undocumented immigrants and protect the rights of immigrant families. Under the banner of Sustainable Prosperity, Milltrust International Group is a specialist, award-winning investment organisation co-headquartered in London and Singapore. Backed by some of the leading local government pension schemes in the United Kingdom, Milltrust has a long history of investing into early-stage companies from leading universities & research institutions. About Greater Philadelphia Tourism Marketing Corporation
--------------------------------------------------------

Mission:  
VISIT PHILADELPHIA® is our name and our mission. As the region’s official tourism marketing agency, we build Greater Philadelphia’s image, drive visitation and boost the economy.  
  
Who We Are:  
Recognizing that leisure tourism could be an important industry for the city and region, the City of Philadelphia, the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania and The Pew Charitable Trusts founded VISIT PHILADELPHIA as the Greater Philadelphia Tourism Marketing Corporation in 1996. The next year, we launched the first consumer campaign inviting people to visit the five-county region (Bucks, Chester, Delaware, Montgomery and Philadelphia counties). Today, Greater Philadelphia welcomes 13.4 million more leisure travelers annually than it did in 1997.  
  
Successful campaigns include the current With Love, Philadelphia XOXO®; Philly’s More Fun When You Sleep Over®, the most successful post-9/11 hospitality recovery campaign in the U.S.; the groundbreaking Philadelphia – Get Your History Straight And Your Nightlife Gay®; and With Art Philadelphia®, the city’s first-ever coordinated and sustained visual arts marketing effort.  
  
Funding:  
A 501(c)3, VISIT PHILADELPHIA funding sources include Philadelphia County hotel tax, foundation grants, Commonwealth of Pennsylvania grants, partnerships and sponsorships. We are not a membership organization.

Additionally, he is dedicated to fostering a culture of compliance through comprehensive GxP training programs that empower teams to uphold the highest standards in clinical operations and development.  
  
With a keen focus on therapeutic areas and clinical trials, James Myers is committed to driving innovation and excellence in the pharmaceutical industry. His ability to bridge the gap between regulatory expectations and practical implementation makes him a valuable asset to any organization striving for quality and compliance in their research and development endeavors. Through KHyMaTe, he continues to set new benchmarks in quality assurance, ensuring that clients not only meet but exceed industry standards.

About Microcamp
---------------

A Microcamp é a principal rede de educação tecnológica do Brasil. Desde sua fundação, em 1977, seus esforços tem contribuído, decisivamente, para o aumento da inclusão digital no país, por meio do ensino de informática, tecnologias de vanguarda e inglês a preços acessíveis. Em mais de 40 anos de mercado, já foram formados mais de dois milhões de alunos no Brasil e no exterior (Portugal, Espanha e Argentina). Atualmente, estão matriculados cerca 120 mil alunos em 65 unidades instaladas em 9 estados brasileiros. Em sua trajetória, a Microcamp sempre buscou conectar inovação às pessoas utilizando uma linguagem leve, simples e criativa. Por esse motivo, seus cursos, Informática com desenvolvimento de aplicativos e realidade mixada, Hardware e Robótica, Design e Desenvolvimento de Games com VR, Produtividade e Pacote Office e Inglês com Inteligência Artificial e Holografia, tornaram-se referência no país. Além dos conhecimentos técnicos de cada curso, os alunos Microcamp desenvolvem competências e habilidades que os motivam a desenvolver atitude empreendedora e a serem protagonistas de suas histórias. Sempre de forma autêntica e com a força de uma comunidade que se completa e se fortalece; favorecendo, dessa forma, a conquista de objetivos pessoais e profissionais.

About Deer Valley Resort
------------------------

Deer Valley Resort, located in the picturesque Wasatch Mountains of Utah, is a premier destination for skiing and outdoor recreation, just 38 miles from Salt Lake City International Airport. Nestled in the historic mining town of Park City, the resort has transformed into a vibrant mountain community, attracting visitors and seasonal workers from across the globe. With a dedicated staff of over 2,800 individuals, Deer Valley prides itself on its diverse workforce, which includes locals, transplants, and international students, creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued and appreciated.  
  
Renowned for its exceptional service and meticulously groomed slopes, Deer Valley Resort offers a range of products and services that cater to both winter sports enthusiasts and summer adventurers. The resort features world-class skiing, with a focus on skier services, mountain operations, and lodging operations, ensuring a seamless experience for guests. In addition to skiing, Deer Valley provides a variety of outdoor activities, including mountain biking, hiking, and summer festivals, making it a year-round destination.  
  
The resort leverages advanced technologies to enhance guest experiences, from state-of-the-art snowmaking systems to efficient lift operations. With numerous indoor and outdoor job opportunities in Food & Beverage, Mountain Operations, and Skier Services, Deer Valley is not just a workplace; it’s a community where over 1,100 staff members celebrated five seasons or more last year. Whether you are 14 or 84, there is a place for you in the Deer Valley family, where the spirit of camaraderie and adventure thrives. Join us and discover a rewarding career in one of the best resorts in the world!

Encore Visual Effects brings creative ideas to fruition, whether crafting superhero-sized spectacles to nuanced VFX. We work hand in hand with each of our production partners to skillfully translate concepts, whether rough, well-honed or somewhere in between, into impactful visuals that complement and enhance the story. Our team of dedicated VFX supervisors and producers impart personalized attention to each project from pre-production planning insight to on-set expertise that ensures captured shots lay the foundation for successful visual effects. We’ve built and continue to grow a comprehensive asset library of photoreal vehicles, environments, creatures, animals, and more; this foundation gives Encore VFX artists and designers a head start for each project so that they can quickly and efficiently deliver the most ambitious visuals on the tightest of deadlines. Encore VFX’s robust roster of artists and global network of facilities provide industry-leading work on hit TV shows, feature films, and beyond. Headquartered in Burbank, California, Encore VFX collaborates on productions worldwide, including tax incentivized locations.

About Motiv Electric Bikes
--------------------------

Every great bicycle starts with a solid platform: the frame. Our frame is designed to be strong and sturdy. You might feel instability or wobbliness on a competitor’s bike, but the advance hydro-forming on our tubes will keep your ride as smooth as possible. We use top tier bicycle component manufacturers such as Shimano and Kenda. Every Motiv bicycle gets tested and undergoes a tough quality control inspection.  
  
What good is electric technology if you have no power? Motiv’s electric system was engineered to have outstanding performance and reliability. It utilizes a 500-watt geared motor and is powered by a lithium-ion battery. We allow you to customize your power system for your specific needs from a 36 volt to a 48 volt system. The 48 volt was developed for an increase of power for riders that live in a hilly area or a personal preference. When selecting this option, please realize that it may exceed the federal speed limit of 20MPH and Motiv does not recommend or condone this.  
  
Sure the bike looks cool, but how it rides is more important. By placing the battery at the middle and lowest part of the frame, the bikes maintain a low center of gravity making for a well-balanced ride. You’ll have no trouble cornering and handling at higher speeds.  
  
We want you to have the trust in us that the science on our bikes is safe as you cruise around. Braking is a huge part of this. Disc brakes are the most powerful and reliable way to stop; that’s why we incorporated two 6-inch disc brakes, one front and one rear.  
  
The bottom line is we are crazy about bikes. As enthusiasts, we want what you, the riders, want. Which is why we have all the color options to satisfy your craving for creativity. Come discover what your Motiv is. You won’t be disappointed.

What types of electric bikes does Motiv Electric Bikes offer?

Are Motiv Electric Bikes suitable for all skill levels?

Yes, Motiv Electric Bikes are designed to accommodate riders of all skill levels. Whether you are a beginner or an experienced cyclist, our bikes feature adjustable settings and user-friendly controls, making it easy for anyone to enjoy the benefits of electric biking.

What is the average range of Motiv Electric Bikes on a single charge?

The average range of Motiv Electric Bikes varies by model, but most bikes can travel between 30 to 70 miles on a single charge, depending on factors such as rider weight, terrain, and assist level. Do Motiv Electric Bikes come with a warranty?

What maintenance is required for Motiv Electric Bikes?

Regular maintenance is essential to keep your Motiv Electric Bike in optimal condition. We recommend checking tire pressure, cleaning the chain, and inspecting the brakes regularly. ISO9001 certified, Zone has the systems in place to manage its customers’ requirements consistently and efficiently on every order. The goal is simple: continually improve the operation in order to provide customers with the lowest cost products in the industry, on-time and without defect.  
  
The management team at Zone is committed to 100% customer satisfaction. As our client’s trusted advisor, Zone is dedicated in meeting and exceeding customer expectations. The Zone team hopes to have the opportunity to serve your company in the near future.

About Emergent Health Partners
------------------------------

Emergent Health Partners is a nonprofit emergency medical services organization providing ALS and BLS EMS services to 1.1 million people in 14 counties of southern Michigan. Emergent Health operates out of Ann Arbor, Michigan with additional regional headquarters in Plymouth, Jackson, Battle Creek, and Monroe. The organization is governed by a volunteer Board of Trustees made up of community leaders from our service area.  
  
Emergent Health’s flagship EMS agency, Huron Valley Ambulance, was founded in 1981. Since its Ann Arbor-based beginnings, HVA has expanded to serve all of Washtenaw County as well as portions of Wayne and Oakland counties. After HVA’s success, it continued to grow by creating four additional ambulance services to provide emergency care throughout Jackson, Monroe, Lenawee, and Calhoun counties.  
  
In 2012, Emergent Health Partners was founded in an effort to bring all five ambulance services together as a strong, cohesive EMS operation. In 2018, Emergent Health expanded to Michigan's west side when LifeCare Ambulance of Battle Creek was added to the organization. This new growth made Emergent Health Partners the largest EMS provider in Michigan.  
  
Emergent Health Partners operates with over 100 ambulances and close to 600 licensed EMTs and paramedics. All of Emergent Health’s EMS operations are accredited by CAAS - the Commission on Accreditation of Ambulance Services. Of the 13,000 ambulance services currently operating in the United States, fewer than 200 are presently CAAS accredited. Maintaining CAAS accreditation assures that Emergent Health Partners prioritizes up-to-date and well-maintained equipment, rigorous employee training, and high-level hiring requirements in order to provide the communities we serve with exemplary pre-hospital emergency care.

About Universidad Popular
-------------------------

Universidad Popular a.k.a. Latin Center, wishes to promote neighborhood development and community empowerment via the pr-axis of participatory learning or popular education. Since its very inception in the early 1970’s, Universidad Popular has adopted the practice of branching itself out to various parts of the city, which explains its presence currently in Chicago Lawn, Pilsen, and Little Village. Universidad Popular’s brand of community work is rotted in the educational philosophy of Paulo Freire, the world renown Latin American educator. For this reason, Universidad Popular believes that in order to succeed in the community, education must be done with the participation of local residents. Due to such a standing, it shies away from traditional paradigms of community work characterized by designing programs for the community. Instead, it chooses to carry out activities, projects and programs such as adult, family, youth and early childhood education with, by and for the community.  
  
  
  
Universidad Popular's confidence in the ability of so-called “voiceless” people to empower themselves has led it to rely on self-help for the conceptualization and implementation of its programs. Today, as always, it depends heavily upon its volunteers—many of whom are current or former program participants—to help others in their quest for improvement. Facilitators and participants work together to design programs of study that stem from and are relevant to their lives. They are tailored to participants’ particular needs.

What types of home care services does Bluebird Care offer?

Bluebird Care provides a wide range of home care services tailored to meet individual needs. These include personal care, dementia care, respite care, domiciliary care, live-in care, and medication management. Our services are designed to support individuals in maintaining their independence while receiving the assistance they need in the comfort of their own homes.

How does Bluebird Care ensure the quality of care provided?

At Bluebird Care, we prioritize quality and safety in our care services. We implement rigorous recruitment processes to hire qualified and compassionate caregivers. Additionally, we provide ongoing training and support to our staff, conduct regular quality checks, and encourage feedback from clients and their families. Our aim is to deliver personalized care that meets the highest standards.

Can Bluebird Care assist individuals with dementia or Alzheimer's?

Yes, Bluebird Care specializes in providing care for individuals with dementia and Alzheimer's. Our trained caregivers understand the unique challenges associated with these conditions and offer compassionate support tailored to each individual's needs. We focus on creating a safe and stimulating environment that promotes well-being and enhances quality of life.

What is live-in care, and how does it work?

Live-in care is a service where a caregiver resides in the client's home to provide continuous support and companionship. This arrangement allows individuals to receive personalized care while remaining in a familiar environment. Live-in caregivers assist with daily activities, personal care, medication management, and companionship, ensuring that clients receive the attention and support they need around the clock.

How can I arrange care services from Bluebird Care?

Arranging care services with Bluebird Care is straightforward. You can start by visiting our website or contacting your local Bluebird Care office directly. We will conduct an initial assessment to understand your specific needs and preferences. Based on this assessment, we will develop a personalized care plan and match you with a suitable caregiver.

Is Bluebird Care available in my area?

Bluebird Care operates across the UK with numerous local offices. To find out if we provide services in your area, please visit our website and enter your postcode or contact your nearest Bluebird Care office. Our team will be happy to assist you and provide information about the services available in your locality.

Celebrating 30 years as a leader in the fashion industry, Mary Frances Shaffer, welcomes you to the wonderful world of Mary Frances Accessories. Mary Frances’ vision and expertise in business have driven her originally home-based business into an international, multi million dollar corporation that employs more than 700 people.  
At the core, Mary Frances’ motivation is to provide objects of pure beauty at an accessible price point. Her handmade treasures are available in over 3000 boutiques and department stores worldwide. Mary Frances Accessories has experience exponential growth over the years – establishing the Mary Frances label as a widely recognized brand.  
Mary Frances is passionate about what she does and knows what her customers are looking for: unique, quality accessories that can express her personality and individual style. Primarily inspired by fabrics, texture and unique combinations of materials and colors, Mary Frances reviews trends, then sets them aside to arrive at a look that is all her own. About Alliance For Safety And Justice
-------------------------------------

The Alliance for Safety and Justice (ASJ), a new project of the Tides Center, aims to replace prison waste with new safety priorities rooted in prevention and community health. To accomplish these goals, ASJ partners with state-based advocates to advance policy reforms that will significantly reduce incarceration rates and racial disparities in the criminal justice system.  
  
In partner states, ASJ will provide support and technical assistance to organizations advancing justice reform through alliance building, issue education, and policy advocacy. ASJ is committed to both reforming state justice systems and empowering the communities most harmed by concentrated crime and over-incarceration. ASJ is the sister organization of Californians for Safety and Justice, a project of the Tides Center (www.safeandjust.org) and Vote Safe, a 501(c)4 project of The Advocacy Fund.

Welcome to the company page of SoftwareNegotiation.com, the website of Marcus Harris who is one of the country’s premier enterprise software negotiation, contract drafting, licensing and litigation attorneys.  
  
Focusing especially on Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), CRM and similar platforms, he has developed one of the nation’s leading practices devoted to representing clients to recover damages arising out of failed ERP implementation.  
  
Marcus also helps clients ensure that their systems comply with the European Union’s General Data Protection Regulations (GDPR) which affects every ERP and CRM vendor whose customers have systems installed in Europe. Under GDPR, if a customer asks that a business erase their name from their records, it must do so quickly. The system also must prove that it is compliant with GDPR even if there hasn’t been a hack or data leak, or face hefty fines.  
  
He also works on copyright, trademark and intellectual property issues for clients including managing global intellectual property portfolios for Fortune 500 companies and does pro bono work for creative artists and individuals filing copyright and trademark applications.  
  
As a partner in the Chicago office of Taft Stettinius & Hollister, a prominent national firm with more than 400 attorneys in 10 offices, Marcus'​ ERM work is part of the Intellectual Property practice and its Privacy & Data Security group.

Where are the myOffice Business Centre locations situated?

Both locations are strategically chosen to provide easy access to key business districts, amenities, and transport links, making them ideal for professionals and businesses looking to establish a presence in the city.

Virtual office services offered by myOffice Business Centre provide businesses with a professional address and essential administrative support without the need for a physical office space. people delivering its projects and services across 27 countries over five continents, including regional offices in Australia, New Zealand, Canada, USA and the UK.  
  
BCEGI launched its UK operation in Manchester in 2013 and UK services including investment, development and construction. BCEGI has a long-term stake in the UK economy, creating jobs and building local communities.  
  
The organisation’s strength and depth of cultural, personal and professional understanding means it is well placed to facilitate and deliver bi-lateral trade, particularly between China and the UK. As members of the Manchester China Forum, BCEGI is a proud ambassador for Manchester, the North West and Northern Powerhouse, and is proactive in helping businesses new to the UK and Europe make valuable connections and build relationships.

Furthermore, Roman is adept at bundle contracting, a growing trend in the healthcare industry that promotes value-based care and cost efficiency.  
  
His strong communication and presentation skills enable him to effectively convey complex information to diverse stakeholders, fostering robust relationships with providers, payers, and partners. Roman's commitment to business development and customer service management ensures that United Surgical Partners International remains competitive in a rapidly evolving healthcare landscape. CleanTech stands committed to excellence in service by combining properly trained personnel and unparalleled effective management. At CleanTech, we believe that "service" is a state of mind.  
  
CleanTech is a member of the Building Service Contractor Association International (BSCAI) whose programs and services help our company maintain its high quality standards.

About LifestyleGarden
---------------------

LifestyleGarden is a sustainable outdoor furniture brand powered by ScanCom International, a leading player in the global outdoor furniture industry for home and commercial use with a wide range of products: sofas, chairs, tables, accessories….  
  
Our goal is to provide innovation and excellence without compromising our vision of “Doing Business the Right Way”.  
  
LifestyleGarden is a pioneer in terms of sustainability and environmental protection, designing the first commercially available chair made 100% with recycled fishing nets and plastics from the oceans: DuraOcean. www.lifestylegarden.com/duraocean  
  
We aim to create outstanding products that combine international design expertise with the latest production techniques and materials that are formulated, manufactured and tested to offer superior performance in a range of outdoor environments. Each LifestyleGarden® piece is made at our state-of-the-art production facilities in Asia and is rigorously tested to international standards for quality, durability and functionality. We only use teak that is FSC™-certified - new timber that has been grown in responsibly managed plantations or recycled teak that has been sourced from components and structures on the island of Java.  
  
Doing Business the Right Way is a cornerstone of our business vision; we believe that it is the only way of operating and the approach can be seen in everything we do: from the sourcing and processing of raw materials, through production and design stages until the final product is delivered to your door.

About Samuel Does

Samuel Doe, the former President of Liberia, rose to power in a military coup in 1980, which led to the brutal assassination of the then-President William R. Tolbert Jr. Doe's ascent to power marked the beginning of a tumultuous period in Liberia's history, characterized by political instability, economic turmoil, and widespread human rights abuses. Despite his initial promise to bring about positive change and development to the country, Doe's leadership was tainted by corruption, repression, and violence.  
  
Born on May 6, 1951, in Tuzon, a small village in Grand Gedeh County, Liberia, Doe had a humble upbringing and did not receive a formal education. He joined the Armed Forces of Liberia in 1971 and quickly rose through the ranks, eventually becoming a master sergeant. In 1980, Doe, along with a group of fellow soldiers, overthrew the government of President Tolbert in a violent coup. Doe assumed the position of head of state, promising to reform the corrupt political system that had plagued Liberia for decades.  
  
Doe's presidency was characterized by a lack of respect for democratic principles and human rights. He suspended the constitution, dissolved the legislature, and established a one-party state under the banner of the National Democratic Party of Liberia. Political opposition was met with violence, and many of Doe's opponents were arrested, tortured, or killed. The regime's human rights abuses were well-documented, including extrajudicial killings, arbitrary arrests, and mistreatment of prisoners.  
  
Economically, Doe's rule was marked by mismanagement, corruption, and the plundering of the country's natural resources. Despite Liberia's significant wealth in natural resources such as diamonds, gold, and timber, the vast majority of the population lived in poverty, and the country's infrastructure was in a state of disrepair. The mismanagement of the economy, coupled with the government's prioritization of personal enrichment, led to widespread discontent and further eroded the legitimacy of Doe's government.  
  
In 1989, Liberia descended into a brutal civil war, fueled by ethnic and political tensions, as well as widespread disenchantment with Doe's rule. The war, which lasted for seven years, resulted in the deaths of hundreds of thousands of people and the displacement of many more. Doe's government was accused of gross human rights violations, including the use of child soldiers, and the war further polarized the country along ethnic and political lines.  
  
In 1990, Doe was captured by rebel forces led by Charles Taylor, a former ally turned adversary, and was brutally executed. His death marked the end of an era of autocratic rule in Liberia, but the legacy of his presidency continued to haunt the country for years to come. The years of conflict and division that followed resulted in a deep-seated distrust of government institutions and a fractured society that took decades to rebuild.  
  
In summary, Samuel Doe's tenure as the President of Liberia was marked by authoritarianism, corruption, and human rights abuses, which ultimately led to the downfall of his regime and the outbreak of a devastating civil war. His legacy serves as a cautionary tale about the dangers of unchecked power and the devastating consequences of political repression and mismanagement. While Liberia has made significant strides towards peace and reconciliation in the years since Doe's rule, the scars of his presidency continue to linger, serving as a reminder of the need for accountable and transparent governance.

Harrisonburg, Virginia is an independent city located in the central Shenandoah Valley region of Virginia. Harrisonburg is located right along Interstate 81 and is only two hours away from both Richmond, Virginia and Washington, D.C. Harrisonburg is recognized as the county seat for Rockingham County.  
  
The City of Harrisonburg operates under a council-manager form of government which combines elected officials in the form of a governing body with an appointed local government manager. The City Manager then oversees the delivery of public services through the city departments. Each city department then has a role in how services are provided to the citizens.

About Another Planet Entertainment
----------------------------------

Another Planet Entertainment, LLC (Another Planet) was created on July 18, 2003 when Gregg W. Perloff, President/CEO of Bill Graham Presents, left to build his own company. Shortly thereafter he was joined by longtime colleagues at Bill Graham Presents Sherry Wasserman, former Senior VP and Head of Concert Production at BGP, and Steve Welkom, former Senior VP of Administration and Business Development for BGP. In November of that year, Allen Scott and his concert promotion company, Mystery Machine Productions merged with APE, solidifying the company's foundation.  
  
On August 16, 2003, Another Planet, in a collaborative effort with Giants Enterprises, presented its first concert featuring Bruce Springsteen & The E Street Band at Pacific Bell Park in San Francisco. Another Planet was selected soon after by Dave Matthews Band to produce and promote its major outdoor benefit concert at Golden Gate Park in San Francisco on September 12, 2004.  
  
Another Planet is the exclusive promoter for the Greek Theatre, an 8,500 capacity outdoor amphitheatre in Berkeley, the Fox Theater in Oakland, the 2,800 capacity venue, The Independent, a 500 capacity nightclub in San Francisco, and the 8,000 capacity Lake Tahoe Outdoor Arena at Harveys. In 2010, APE was honored to be awarded the exclusive contract to operate the historic Bill Graham Civic Auditorium in San Francisco, a flexible capacity multi-use event and concert space that holds up to 8,500. Another Planet has also successfully produced two major festivals in San Francisco – Outside Lands Music & Arts Festival (beginning in 2008) and Treasure Island Music Festival (beginning in 2007).

Her commitment to excellence in publishing is evident in her meticulous approach to drawing and photography, ensuring that every illustrated book not only informs but also captivates its audience. What types of branding services does Ascendant Group offer?

Ascendant Group specializes in a comprehensive range of branding services, including brand strategy development, brand management, and execution. We work closely with our clients to create a cohesive brand identity that resonates with their target audience. Our services also extend to photography, social media management, and public relations, ensuring that every aspect of your brand is professionally represented.

How does Ascendant Group approach brand strategy for executives?

At Ascendant Group, we understand that personal branding is crucial for executives and CEOs. Our approach involves a thorough analysis of the individual’s strengths, values, and unique selling points. We then develop a tailored brand strategy that enhances their public persona, leveraging platforms like LinkedIn and Instagram to build a strong online presence. Our goal is to position executives as thought leaders in their industry.

Can Ascendant Group assist with social media management?

Yes, Ascendant Group offers social media management services as part of our branding solutions. We create and implement tailored social media strategies that align with your brand's goals. Our team manages content creation, scheduling, and engagement across various platforms, including Instagram and LinkedIn, to ensure your brand maintains a consistent and impactful online presence.

What industries does Ascendant Group serve?

Ascendant Group has experience working across a diverse range of industries, including technology, finance, healthcare, and consumer goods. Our team is adept at understanding the unique challenges and opportunities within each sector, allowing us to provide customized branding solutions that meet the specific needs of our clients, whether they are Fortune 500 companies or emerging startups.

How does Ascendant Group ensure the success of its branding projects?

We prioritize collaboration and communication with our clients throughout the branding process. Ascendant Group employs a structured methodology that includes research, strategy development, execution, and ongoing evaluation. We set clear objectives and key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the success of our branding initiatives, ensuring that we deliver results that align with our clients' business goals.

What is the process for starting a project with Ascendant Group?

To start a project with Ascendant Group, potential clients can reach out through our website or contact us directly. We begin with an initial consultation to discuss your branding needs and objectives. Following this, we conduct a detailed assessment of your current brand positioning and market landscape. From there, we develop a customized proposal outlining our recommended strategies and services, allowing you to make an informed decision before moving forward.

About Alice Cooper

Alice Cooper, born Vincent Damon Furnier, is an iconic American singer known for his provocative stage presence and dark, theatrical music. With a career spanning over five decades, Cooper has solidified himself as a pioneer of shock rock and a master of blending heavy metal, glam rock, and horror imagery into a captivating and immersive experience for his fans.  
  
Starting with his early band, Alice Cooper, which eventually became his stage name, Cooper quickly built a reputation for his wild, boundary-pushing performances. His music often delves into themes of darkness, rebellion, and the macabre, creating an intense and electrifying atmosphere during his live shows. His charismatic and unpredictable stage persona combined with his distinct, gritty vocals have made him a true rock legend.  
  
Cooper's breakthrough came with the release of his third album, "Love It to Death," in 1971, which featured the hit single "I'm Eighteen." This marked the beginning of his rise to fame, as the album garnered significant attention and propelled him into the spotlight. His 1972 album, "School's Out," solidified his status as a rock superstar, with its title track becoming an anthem for rebellious youth. As his popularity soared, Cooper continued to push the boundaries of rock music, incorporating elaborate stage theatrics, props, and costumes into his live performances.  
  
In addition to his musical prowess, Cooper's influence extends beyond the stage. He has been a powerful force in shaping the culture of rock music, inspiring a new generation of artists to embrace theatricality and spectacle in their performances. His impact can be felt across various genres, as he has left an indelible mark on the realms of heavy metal, punk, and glam rock.  
  
As a performer, Cooper has never shied away from controversy. His on-stage antics have often sparked outrage and debate, but it is precisely this willingness to challenge societal norms that has made him such a compelling and enduring figure in the world of music. His ability to shock and provoke has only served to further cement his status as a trailblazer in the industry.  
  
In addition to his solo career, Cooper has also collaborated with other artists, lending his unmistakable voice to a wide range of musical projects. He has worked with renowned musicians such as Aerosmith, Slash, and Rob Zombie, demonstrating his versatility and adaptability as an artist. His ability to seamlessly blend with different musical styles and artists further showcases his exceptional talent and enduring relevance.  
  
Throughout his career, Cooper has amassed a dedicated fanbase, affectionately known as the "Sick Things," who have remained loyal to him through the years. His influence on popular culture is undeniable, as his music continues to resonate with audiences around the world. Cooper's impact on the music industry has been recognized with numerous accolades and honors, solidifying his place in the pantheon of rock music.  
  
As a living legend, Alice Cooper has shown no signs of slowing down. His passion for music and his dedication to his craft are as strong as ever, and he continues to captivate audiences with his electrifying performances. With each new project, he continues to push the boundaries of rock music, proving that he is truly a force to be reckoned with in the world of entertainment.  
  
In conclusion, Alice Cooper's impact on the world of rock music cannot be overstated. His fearless approach to performance and his ability to connect with audiences on a visceral level have cemented his status as a rock icon. His enduring influence on rock music and popular culture is a testament to his talent, creativity, and unparalleled stage presence. Alice Cooper's legacy will undoubtedly continue to inspire and influence generations of musicians and fans for years to come.

What services does MHC Automation offer for digital transformation?

MHC Automation specializes in a range of services aimed at facilitating digital transformation for organizations. Our solutions include document automation, accounts payable automation, and workflow automation, which help streamline core business processes. We also provide document management and imaging services, ensuring that organizations can efficiently create, capture, and distribute documents and communications. Our expertise in integrating with ERP systems further enhances the effectiveness of our solutions.

How can MHC Automation help with accounts payable automation?

MHC Automation offers comprehensive accounts payable automation solutions that simplify and accelerate the invoice processing workflow. Our services include automated document capture using OCR technology, which reduces manual data entry and minimizes errors. We also provide tools for electronic payments and document delivery, ensuring that invoices are processed quickly and accurately. By automating these processes, organizations can improve efficiency, reduce costs, and enhance visibility into their financial operations.

What industries does MHC Automation support?

MHC Automation serves a diverse range of industries, including finance, healthcare, manufacturing, and retail. Our solutions are designed to meet the unique needs of each sector, helping organizations tackle challenges related to document management, process automation, and compliance. Whether it's improving the efficiency of accounts payable in finance or streamlining patient communication in healthcare, MHC provides tailored solutions that drive digital transformation across various industries.

Can MHC Automation integrate with existing ERP systems?

Yes, MHC Automation specializes in ERP integration, allowing our solutions to seamlessly connect with your existing enterprise resource planning systems. This integration ensures that data flows smoothly between systems, enhancing the efficiency of business processes. Our team works closely with clients to customize integrations that fit their specific needs, enabling organizations to leverage their current technology investments while enhancing their document and workflow automation capabilities.

What is the role of document imaging in MHC Automation's services?

Document imaging plays a crucial role in MHC Automation's offerings by enabling organizations to digitize their paper documents, making them easily accessible and manageable. Our document imaging solutions help capture, store, and retrieve documents efficiently, reducing physical storage needs and improving compliance with regulatory requirements. By converting paper documents into digital formats, organizations can enhance their document management processes and support better decision-making through improved access to information.

How does MHC Automation ensure the security of document processing?

MHC Automation prioritizes the security of document processing through a combination of advanced technology and best practices. Our solutions include secure document capture and storage, ensuring that sensitive information is protected at all stages of processing. We implement robust access controls and encryption methods to safeguard data from unauthorized access. Additionally, our compliance with industry standards and regulations helps organizations maintain the integrity and confidentiality of their documents throughout the automation process.

Convertagraphics specializes in bind-in order form envelopes, two-way mailers, and photo packaging. These products are ideal for catalog companies and businesses looking to enhance their mailing efficiency and presentation.

Double Envelope operates manufacturing plants in Virginia, Maryland, Florida, and Indiana. This regional presence allows us to efficiently serve our clients across the East Coast and beyond, ensuring timely delivery and high-quality products.

What types of services does Fraser Dove International offer?

Fraser Dove International specializes in a range of talent consultancy services tailored specifically for the life sciences industry. Our offerings include executive search, talent solutions, and consulting services. We focus on various functions such as quality, procurement, market intelligence, R&D, engineering, regulatory affairs, and commercial operations, ensuring that we meet the diverse needs of our clients in the life sciences sector.

How does Fraser Dove International differentiate itself from traditional recruitment agencies?

Unlike traditional recruitment agencies, Fraser Dove International operates exclusively within the life sciences industry, allowing us to develop deep expertise and a nuanced understanding of the market. We provide a comprehensive suite of services beyond just recruitment, including strategic consulting and market intelligence, which helps our clients navigate complex challenges and make informed decisions about their talent needs.

What industries does Fraser Dove International support?

Fraser Dove International supports a variety of sectors within the life sciences industry, including pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, medical devices, and healthcare. Our specialized knowledge enables us to effectively address the unique challenges and requirements of these industries, ensuring that we deliver the best talent solutions for our clients.

Can Fraser Dove International assist with regulatory affairs recruitment?

Yes, Fraser Dove International has a dedicated focus on regulatory affairs recruitment. Our team understands the critical importance of regulatory compliance in the life sciences sector and is equipped to identify and attract top talent in this field. We work closely with clients to understand their specific regulatory needs and source candidates who possess the necessary expertise and experience.

What is the process for engaging Fraser Dove International's services?

Engaging Fraser Dove International's services typically begins with an initial consultation to discuss your specific talent needs and objectives. From there, we conduct a thorough analysis of the market and your requirements, followed by a tailored search strategy. Our team will present qualified candidates and provide ongoing support throughout the recruitment process to ensure a successful placement.

Does Fraser Dove International offer services for executive-level positions?

Absolutely. Fraser Dove International specializes in executive recruitment, focusing on sourcing and placing senior-level talent within the life sciences industry. Our executive search process is designed to identify leaders who not only possess the right skills and experience but also align with your organization's culture and strategic goals.

Torstar Printing Group is one of the largest cold web printers in Canada. Wir sehen zwei Arten von Glück. Das unserer Kundinnen und Kunden und das unserer Teams. Wer besser sieht und hört, kann sein Leben wieder in vollen Zügen genießen. Wer die Freiheit hat, durchzustarten und seine eigene Karriere zu gestalten, strahlt jeden Tag.  
  
Was uns ausmacht, können wir kurz und knapp beschreiben: mehr Wir-Gefühl, mehr Gestaltungsfreiheit, mehr Erfolg. Dadurch haben wir alle spürbar mehr vom Leben – das gesamte #TeamApollo und alle Kundinnen und Kunden, die eine der rund 900 Apollo-Filialen in Deutschland betreten. Hier verhelfen wir täglich tausenden Menschen zu besserem Sehen und Hören. Dank uns schärfen sie wieder ihre Sinne und entdecken die Welt neu. Sinnvoller kann ein Job kaum sein.  
  
Apollo wurde 1972 gegründet und gehört dem internationalen Optikkonzern GrandVision an, der seit 2021 Teil der EssilorLuxottica-Gruppe ist. Ein Großteil der Brillen, die in den Filialen oder im Apollo.de Onlineshop erworben werden, wird in der hauseigenen Fertigung im mittelfränkischen Schwabach fertiggestellt, wo auch die Dienstleistungszentrale seit 1998 ihren Sitz hat.  
  
Werden Sie Teil des #TeamApollo  
Wenn Sie Teamplay lieben, Bereitschaft zur Weiterbildung und Interesse am Thema Brille bzw. Mode mitbringen, dann sind Sie bei Apollo goldrichtig – auch als Quereinsteiger – sowohl in unseren Filialen als auch in der Apollo Dienstleistungszentrale.  
  
Mehr dazu unter https://karriere.apollo.de/

What is Tiki and how does it support creators?

Tiki is a global short video app developed in India, aimed at empowering creators to showcase their talents and connect with a vibrant community. The platform offers various tools and features that allow users to create, edit, and share short videos easily. Tiki also provides monetization opportunities, enabling creators to earn from their content while fostering a supportive environment for collaboration and growth.

What types of content can I create on Tiki?

Tiki supports a wide range of content types, including comedy skits, dance performances, educational videos, DIY projects, and more. The platform encourages creativity, allowing users to express themselves through innovative storytelling and engaging visuals. With various editing tools and effects available, creators can enhance their videos to capture the attention of their audience.

Is Tiki available for businesses and brands?

Yes, Tiki offers solutions for businesses and brands looking to engage with a younger audience through short video content. Brands can collaborate with creators for promotional campaigns, utilize Tiki's advertising options, and leverage user-generated content to enhance their marketing strategies. The platform provides insights and analytics to help businesses measure the impact of their campaigns effectively.

What industries does Tiki cater to?

Tiki caters to a diverse range of industries, including entertainment, education, fashion, beauty, food, and technology. The platform is designed to support various content creators, from influencers to educators, enabling them to reach their target audiences effectively. By fostering a community of creators from different sectors, Tiki helps promote cross-industry collaboration and innovation.

How does Tiki ensure a safe and positive environment for users?

Tiki prioritizes user safety and community guidelines to create a positive environment for all users. The platform employs content moderation practices to review and remove inappropriate content. Additionally, Tiki encourages users to report any violations of community standards. The company is committed to fostering a respectful and inclusive space where creators can thrive without fear of harassment or negativity.

Can I monetize my content on Tiki, and how does it work?

Yes, Tiki provides monetization options for creators through various programs, including brand partnerships, sponsored content, and ad revenue sharing. Creators can apply to join the Tiki Creator Fund, which rewards them based on their content's performance and engagement. This allows talented individuals to earn income while doing what they love, further motivating them to produce high-quality content.

About The Unlimited Path, Inc.
------------------------------

The Unlimited Path of Central Florida, Inc. was incorporated in 1994 and is a multi-program agency partnering with DOC to support offender's needs in FL. The corporate office is located in Panama City, FL and have more than 80 employees working in correctional institutions. We have been providing substance abuse and mental health services to the offender population for over 17 years in residential and outpatient settings.  
  
In 1997 residential therapeutic community substance abuse treatment was implemented for the Department of Corrections and later, incorporated residential substance abuse treatment program curriculum designed by the Federal Bureau of Prisons as an alternative for offenders resistant to 12 step philosophy.  
  
President and founder, Bertrand Randolph has 24 years in substance abuse services. He has a M.S. in Public Administration, M.S. in Counseling and Psychology, B.S in Addiction Studies, and B.A. in Business Administration. He is also a Licensed Mental Health Counselor, Certified Addiction Professional, Certified Batterer’s Intervention Facilitator and Certified Juvenile Sex Offender Counselor.  
  
Mission statement: "To improve the quality of life within the community by serving offenders, both incarcerated and recently released, and their family members through substance abuse counseling, mental health counseling, education, prevention activities and re-entry efforts enabling offenders to become productive, law-abiding citizens."

What services does DUO provide to students and educational institutions?

DUO offers a range of services including student financing, information on educational programs, and the organization of exams. For students, DUO manages the application process for student loans, grants, and scholarships, ensuring they have the financial support needed to pursue their education. For educational institutions, DUO provides essential data and resources to help them manage student enrollment and funding effectively.

How can I apply for student financing through DUO?

To apply for student financing, you need to create an account on the DUO website. Once registered, you can fill out the application form for student loans, grants, or scholarships. Make sure to have your personal details, educational information, and any necessary documentation ready. After submission, you will receive confirmation and further instructions on how to proceed with your application.

What types of exams does DUO organize?

DUO organizes a variety of exams including national exams for secondary education, vocational education, and higher education. They also manage the administration of standardized tests and assessments that are crucial for evaluating student performance and ensuring educational standards are met across the Netherlands.

How does DUO support educational institutions in managing student data?

DUO provides educational institutions with access to a comprehensive database that includes student enrollment information, financial aid status, and exam results. This data helps institutions track student progress, manage funding allocations, and ensure compliance with educational regulations. Additionally, DUO offers training and resources to help institutions effectively utilize this data.

What information can I find on the DUO website regarding educational programs?

The DUO website offers extensive information about various educational programs available in the Netherlands, including details on vocational training, higher education options, and adult education. Users can find guidance on choosing the right program, understanding admission requirements, and exploring financial aid options available for different educational paths.

How does DUO ensure the security and privacy of personal data?

DUO takes the security and privacy of personal data very seriously. They comply with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and implement stringent security measures to protect sensitive information. This includes secure data storage, restricted access to personal data, and regular audits to ensure compliance with privacy laws. Users can find more information on their data protection policies on the DUO website.

About Hoda Katebi

Hoda Katebi is a prominent American writer and activist, best known for her advocacy work in the realm of social justice, particularly with a focus on Muslim-American identity, fashion, and anti-imperialism. Her writings and public appearances have sparked important conversations about cultural representation, diversity, and inclusivity, and have helped to amplify the voices of marginalized communities across the United States and beyond.  
  
Born in Oklahoma to Iranian immigrant parents, Katebi's upbringing in a predominantly white, conservative town instilled in her a deep sense of otherness and alienation. Her experiences of discrimination and prejudice as a Muslim-American woman have greatly informed her activism and writing, and have fueled her passion for promoting greater understanding and acceptance of diversity. Katebi's work highlights the intersectionality of race, religion, and gender, and aims to challenge stereotypes and misconceptions that persist in today's society.  
  
One of Katebi's most notable contributions to the discourse on representation and identity is her acclaimed book "Tehran Streetstyle," in which she explores the fashion and expressiveness of Iranian youth amid the backdrop of social and political turmoil. By celebrating the creativity and individuality of young Iranians, Katebi seeks to counteract the negative stereotypes and misconceptions that prevail in the Western media, presenting a more nuanced and authentic perspective of Iranian culture and society.  
  
In addition to her literary endeavors, Katebi is a vocal advocate for ethical and sustainable fashion, using her platform to shed light on the environmental and labor injustices perpetuated by the global fashion industry. She has utilized her popular blog, "JooJoo Azad," to raise awareness about the true cost of fast fashion and to promote the importance of conscious consumerism. Through her writings and public speaking engagements, she has encouraged her audience to consider the ethical implications of their purchasing habits and has inspired many to embrace more sustainable and socially responsible approaches to fashion.  
  
Katebi's activism extends beyond her work in literature and fashion, as she has also been an outspoken critic of U.S. foreign policy and military intervention in the Middle East. She has leveraged her platform to call attention to the adverse impacts of imperialism, particularly on the lives of civilians in countries like Iran and Iraq, and has advocated for a more humane and ethical approach to international diplomacy and conflict resolution. By amplifying the voices of those directly affected by war and displacement, Katebi has helped to raise awareness about the human cost of geopolitical power struggles and has urged her audience to critically examine the narratives propagated by mainstream media and political discourse.  
  
In recognition of her contributions to social justice and diversity advocacy, Katebi has received numerous accolades and honors, including being named as one of BBC's 100 Women in 2020. Her work has resonated with a wide audience, both within the Muslim-American community and beyond, and has garnered widespread praise for its thought-provoking and impactful nature. As a passionate and articulate spokesperson for inclusivity and human rights, Hoda Katebi continues to use her platform to challenge societal norms and inspire others to join her in the fight for a more just and equitable world.

About The Ohio State University College of Medicine
---------------------------------------------------

For more than a century, The Ohio State University College of Medicine has been a leader in innovative programs, initiatives and curriculum. As one of the largest and most diverse academic medical centers in the country, we’ve trained more than 20,000 physicians and countless thousands of other affiliated health care professionals. Our college features 19 clinical departments, seven basic science departments and an outstanding School of Health and Rehabilitation Sciences offering undergraduate, masters and PhD programs.  
  
Ohio State Wexner Medical Center, located in one of the most comprehensive health sciences campuses in America – with colleges of Medicine, Nursing, Pharmacy, Dentistry, Optometry, Public Health and Veterinary Medicine in close proximity – is part of The Ohio State University campus. This proximity fosters collaborations with other university departments, which makes Ohio State unique in its potential to promote scientific partnerships and the direct translation of research discoveries into new medical therapies and technologies. We offer dual-degree programs such as MD/MBA, MD/JD, MD/PhD and MD/MHA in collaboration with the Fisher College of Business, the College of Law and the College of Public Health.  
  
The only academic medical center in central Ohio is at the forefront of medicine, where discovery and innovation in research laboratories make unique, effective therapies available to patients months, even years, before other hospitals. These initiatives are taking place within #OSUCOM.

About Athletico

For more than 30 years we’ve been helping remove pain and discomfort from people’s lives. Our patients trust in our expertise, which is why 98 percent would recommend us to a friend – because we were able to help make their lives better. – Athletico Physical Therapy, Better for Every Body  
  
Athletico Physical Therapy is a leading provider of the highest quality orthopedic rehabilitation services to communities, employers and athletes. With the recent acquisition of Pivot Physical Therapy, Athletico operates more than 900 locations in 24 states and the District of Columbia. We are committed to our patients and referring physicians through our patient-centric focus, inclusive work environment, and attention to quality and high standard of care. Delivering market-leading patient outcomes and satisfaction are at the core of what we do, as measured by our industry leading patient satisfaction scores and recognition as a National Top-Tier Provider by the CMS Quality Payment Program. We are also passionate about giving back to the communities we serve through outreach, volunteer and fundraising initiatives supported by the Athletico Cares Foundation. Our comprehensive services include physical and occupational therapy, workers' compensation and onsite employer services, athletic training, and over 50 specialty services, including free assessments, pelvic health, spine health, hand therapy, concussion management, and more.  
  
We are proud to be the official physical therapy or athletic training partner to over 250 organizations of all levels, including professional sports teams, colleges, high schools, elite endurance events, professional dance companies, gymnastics programs, club sports, special events, and more. We support these organizations in many ways, including on-site consultation and injury evaluation, physical therapy, athletic training, or educational sessions.

What types of pilot training programs does AeroGuard Flight Training Center offer?

AeroGuard Flight Training Center offers a variety of pilot training programs designed to meet the needs of aspiring pilots at different stages of their careers. Our programs include Private Pilot License (PPL), Instrument Rating (IR), Commercial Pilot License (CPL), Multi-Engine Training (MEI), Certified Flight Instructor (CFI), and Certified Flight Instructor Instrument (CFII). We also provide FAA 141 training programs that ensure compliance with global aviation training requirements.

What is the duration of the commercial pilot training program at AeroGuard?

The duration of the commercial pilot training program at AeroGuard is designed to be accelerated, allowing students to complete their training in as little as 6 to 12 months, depending on their prior experience and the intensity of their training schedule. Our career-oriented approach ensures that students receive the highest quality aviation instruction while preparing for a successful career in aviation.

Does AeroGuard provide training for international students?

Yes, AeroGuard Flight Training Center welcomes international students and provides comprehensive support to help them navigate the training process in the United States. We assist with visa applications, housing arrangements, and adapting to the U.S. aviation regulations, ensuring a smooth transition for students from around the world.

What are the prerequisites for enrolling in the flight training programs at AeroGuard?

To enroll in the flight training programs at AeroGuard, candidates must meet certain prerequisites. For the Private Pilot License (PPL), students must be at least 17 years old and have a valid medical certificate. For advanced programs like the Commercial Pilot License (CPL), students typically need to have completed their PPL and possess a minimum number of flight hours. It is recommended that candidates contact our admissions team for specific requirements based on the program they are interested in.

What kind of aircraft does AeroGuard use for flight training?

AeroGuard Flight Training Center utilizes a fleet of modern, well-maintained aircraft for flight training, including single-engine and multi-engine planes. Our fleet is equipped with the latest technology to provide students with a realistic and effective training experience. We prioritize safety and quality, ensuring that all aircraft meet FAA standards and are regularly inspected.

How does AeroGuard ensure the quality of its flight instruction?

AeroGuard is committed to providing the highest quality aviation instruction through a combination of experienced flight instructors, structured training programs, and a focus on safety. Our instructors are certified and have extensive flight experience, allowing them to deliver personalized training tailored to each student's needs. Additionally, we continuously evaluate and update our training materials and methods to align with industry standards and best practices.

In her current role, Anda leads key projects that focus on R&D and product commercialization, ensuring that innovative medical solutions are effectively communicated to both external and internal stakeholders. Her proficiency in medical writing and project management allows her to oversee the planning and execution of publications and scientific events, fostering an environment of collaboration and knowledge sharing among healthcare professionals. Anda is particularly adept at developing and implementing medical education initiatives that enhance understanding and engagement in complex therapeutic areas.  
  
Her skills in digital learning and marketing communications further enable her to create impactful educational materials that resonate with diverse audiences. By combining her scientific acumen with strategic communication techniques, Anda is committed to advancing the field of medical communications, ultimately improving patient outcomes through informed healthcare practices. Nurses On Call, Inc. is a locally owned temporary nurse staffing agency in the Florida Panhandle area. About SA Labels Ltd
-------------------

Located in the picturesque heart of Bronte Country in West Yorkshire SA Labels Ltd is one of the UK's largest independent and International Award Winning printers of bespoke high quality Pressure Sensitive labels.  
  
Recognised as one of the UK's leading specialist Printers of PSL to the Drinks Industry our advisory expertise, technical support and supply chain management services encompass every aspect of your requirement from label concept to final application.  
With our acquired and extensive in-depth knowledge of the Drinks Industry we are renowned for bringing distinctive and award winning print and application solutions to a wide spectrum of label requirements.  
  
SA Labels Ltd is the home of ULTRAFLEX, the world's first and exclusive print solution system created by SA Labels Ltd.  
Ultraflex offers an uncompromising choice in print process configuration and multiple decorative enhancements such as foils, tactile finishes and varnishes across a wide range of Pressure Sensitive substrates and Flexible Packaging materials.  
In the quest for differentation, many of today's premium beverages, food and personal care packaging briefs are becoming increasingly more challenging and complex in design. As such, the design content can often be compromised by print restrictions. With Ultraflex those compromises can now be eliminated leaving little to in the imagination for visionary and creative label design.
