About Tobener Ravenscroft LLP
-----------------------------

Tobener Ravenscroft LLP is dedicated to fighting for tenant & renter rights in San Jose, Oakland, San Francisco & surrounding Bay Area cities. We have successfully represented thousands of tenants and victims of landlord caused injuries. Our tenant lawyers stop landlord harassment, refusal to repair, & wrongful evictions. In rent-controlled jurisdictions, we fight illegal rent increases, landlord move-in evictions (OMIs and RMIs), Ellis Act evictions, and evictions for renovations and capital improvements.  
  
Joseph Tobener is a partner attorney. An attorney for more than fifteen years, Mr. Tobener draws on his specialized tenant law expertise to provide caring, easy-to-understand, and aggressive assistance to a diverse clientele. He has represented thousands of Bay Area residents on tenant law issues and earned millions on behalf of his clients. He has appeared on KALW and KQED and was featured in the SF Bay Guardian, the Daily Journal, and California Lawyer. Cases he has successfully litigated have been featured in the San Francisco Chronicle, the New York Times, Reuters, and Wired. His clients have included countless lawyers, high-tech executives, mobile home residents, the San Francisco Tenants Union, and several art collectives. One of his passions is working to preserve artist live/work housing. He also worked for Home Base, a homelessness law nonprofit and has been an adjunct professor at San Francisco State University and UC Hastings. The firm is dedicated to employee activism, and sponsors each of its lawyers to volunteer weekly in the community at housing rights nonprofits, donating nearly 500 attorney hours each year.

About Mathrubhumi
-----------------

Conceived as the mouthpiece of India's freedom movement, Mathrubhumi is one of the front-runners among the Malayalam newspapers. The first copy of Mathrubhumi was published on 18th March 1923 - the day before the first anniversary of Mahatma Gandhi's arrest for the first time by the British police. Led by K.P. Kesava Menon, the prominent freedom fighter, as Editor and K. Madhavan Nair as Managing Director, Mathrubhumi was envisaged for spreading the message of the great National Movement.  
  
Now with 16 editions- 10 in Kerala , one each in New Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Chennai, Qatar & Dubai- it has an impressive circulation of over 1.5 million copies.  
  
In 1979 the Company launched Grihalakshmi, a magazine exclusively for the women of Kerala. Chitrabhumi in 1982, a magazine catering the interests of the Malayalam movie buffs, followed it. Mathrubhumi's other publications are Thozhilvartha, Mathrubhumi Sports Masika, Balabhumi, Mathrubhumi ArogyaMasika, Mathrubhumi Yathra, Mathrubhumi Minnaminni & Cartoon Plus, which was later replaced with a monthly "Mathrubhumi Chithrakatha". Our Annual "Mathrubhumi Year Book " is published both in Malayalam and English. Celebrity lifestyle Magazine "Mathrubhumi Star & Style" replaced Chithrabhumi in 2013. Mathrubhumi Books, the publishing house, has already made a mark of its own in Malayalam Publishing industry.  
  
On 5th September, 1997 the Company launched the online edition www.mathrubhumi.com. Mathrubhumi operates 5 FM Radio stations under the name "CLUB FM". Mathrubhumi Music is the music label owned by the company. On January 2013 Mathrubhumi launched its first Television Channel, "Mathrubhumi News" , a 24x7 Malayalam News Channel. "Kappa TV" a speciality entertainment channel was launched in February 2013. Redmic, launched in 2015, is the events division of Mathrubhumi. Silverbullet, a joint venture of Mathrubhumi launched in 2017, is an E-learning platform for engineering and medical entrance aspirants.

What types of products can I find on Catch.com.au?

How does Catch.com.au ensure the best prices for customers?

At Catch.com.au, we are committed to providing our customers with the best prices possible. We achieve this through strategic partnerships with suppliers, bulk purchasing, and regular promotions and discounts. Additionally, our price match guarantee allows customers to shop with confidence, knowing they are getting the best deal.

What is the delivery process for orders placed on Catch.com.au?

Once you place an order on Catch.com.au, our team processes it quickly to ensure prompt delivery. We offer various shipping options, including standard and express delivery, depending on your needs. Does Catch.com.au offer any loyalty programs or rewards for frequent shoppers?

Additionally, we frequently run exclusive promotions and sales for our members, so be sure to sign up for our newsletter to stay updated.

What industries does Catch.com.au cater to?

About California Canoe & Kayak, Inc.
------------------------------------

Welcome to California Canoe & Kayak, the West's finest and most extensive Paddlesports company since 1972! Our stores carry the latest in kayaks, canoes, stand up paddle boards and equipment for sea kayaking, whitewater kayaking, kayak fishing, canoeing and SUP-ing. We have been committed to providing safe and enjoyable classes and trips for 40 years and would love to have you join us this year.  
  
Our mission is to provide the best instruction possible - whether in a sea kayak, whitewater kayak, canoe or recreational boat. Our goal is to help you discover the joy and freedom of paddling and to provide you with the instruction you need to become the paddler you want to be. Our teaching style is interactive and action-oriented. Our curriculum is nationally recognized for teaching kayaking safely and effectively, at all levels. Our instructors are the best in the business. We accept no less.  
  
We provide a dynamic learning environment for our students and a flexible curriculum, keeping our program creative, original and current.  
  
We strive to carry the best products available to get you on the water in whatever way is right for you. Our staff is committed to matching your needs with the right gear; we are all paddlers, and we love to share our passion! We love to work with our customers to identify what their needs are, not only for today, but as they grow with the sport.  
  
Our commitment extends to the community and the environment as well. We actively support Friends of the River, the Tuolumne River Trust, American Whitewater, Save San Francisco Bay and others in their efforts to preserve wild rivers, clean oceans and pristine coastlines. Our special events enhance paddlesports, build community, and raise money to support local kids and non-profit organizations. This commitment is just one of the reasons we were voted 'Retailer of the Year' by Canoe & Kayak Magazine in 2000.  
  
Come experience the adventure that's waiting for you in your own backyard!

McEntee Law Group exclusively handles immigration cases. Our firm values your personal experience and approaches every case with empathy and care. As many of us have personal immigration experiences ourselves, we know firsthand how complex the immigration system can be, and firmly believe that no one should have to go it alone. Our lawyers are in a unique position to provide sensitive, compassionate, and comprehensive advice to our clients.

### Frequently Asked Questions about McEntee Law Group

What types of immigration cases does McEntee Law Group handle?

McEntee Law Group specializes in a wide range of immigration cases, including asylum applications, family-based immigration, employment-based immigration, and investor visas. Our team is well-versed in handling cases for artists, entertainers, and professional athletes, as well as providing assistance with citizenship applications and green card processes.

How does McEntee Law Group support clients from diverse backgrounds?

As an immigrant-founded and run law firm, McEntee Law Group prides itself on having a diverse team of lawyers and staff who understand the unique challenges faced by immigrants. Our personal experiences enable us to provide compassionate and tailored legal support to clients from various cultural and linguistic backgrounds, ensuring that they feel understood and supported throughout the immigration process.

What is the process for applying for a green card through family sponsorship?

The process for applying for a green card through family sponsorship typically involves several steps. First, a U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident must file a petition for their relative. Once the petition is approved, the relative can apply for a green card, either through adjustment of status if they are already in the U.S. or through consular processing if they are outside the U.S. McEntee Law Group can guide you through each step, ensuring that all paperwork is completed accurately and submitted on time.

What are the eligibility requirements for an H-1B visa?

The H-1B visa is designed for foreign workers in specialty occupations that require theoretical or technical expertise in specialized fields. To be eligible, applicants must have a job offer from a U.S. employer, possess at least a bachelor's degree or its equivalent in the relevant field, and the employer must demonstrate that they are paying the prevailing wage for the position. McEntee Law Group can assist both employers and employees in navigating the H-1B application process.

Can McEntee Law Group assist with asylum applications?

Yes, McEntee Law Group has extensive experience in handling asylum applications. We understand that seeking asylum is often a complex and sensitive process, and we are committed to providing compassionate legal support to individuals fleeing persecution. Our attorneys will work closely with you to gather the necessary documentation, prepare your application, and represent you during any hearings or interviews.

What should I do if my visa application is denied?

If your visa application is denied, it is important to understand the reasons for the denial. McEntee Law Group can help you analyze the denial notice and explore your options, which may include filing an appeal, submitting a motion to reopen or reconsider, or reapplying with stronger documentation. Our team is dedicated to helping you navigate the complexities of immigration law and find the best path forward.

What services does LLamasoft offer to enhance supply chain design?

LLamasoft provides a range of services aimed at optimizing supply chain design, including strategic planning, cost-to-serve optimization, multi-echelon inventory optimization, network simulation, production modeling, and transportation route optimization. These services help organizations create resilient and agile supply chains by leveraging advanced analytics and comprehensive data models.

How can LLamasoft's solutions help in cost-to-serve optimization?

LLamasoft's cost-to-serve optimization solutions enable businesses to analyze and understand the true costs associated with serving different customers and products. By utilizing advanced modeling techniques, companies can identify cost drivers, evaluate service levels, and make informed decisions to enhance profitability while maintaining customer satisfaction.

What industries can benefit from LLamasoft's supply chain solutions?

LLamasoft's supply chain solutions are applicable across various industries, including manufacturing, retail, consumer goods, healthcare, and logistics. Each industry can leverage LLamasoft's advanced analytics and modeling capabilities to address unique supply chain challenges, optimize operations, and improve overall efficiency.

Can LLamasoft's tools integrate with existing supply chain systems?

Yes, LLamasoft's tools are designed to integrate seamlessly with existing supply chain systems and enterprise resource planning (ERP) software. This interoperability allows organizations to enhance their current capabilities without the need for extensive system overhauls, thereby maximizing the value of their existing investments.

What is network simulation, and how does it benefit supply chain management?

Network simulation is a technique used to model and analyze supply chain networks to understand how changes in variables such as demand, supply, and logistics can impact overall performance. By using LLamasoft's network simulation tools, businesses can test different scenarios, optimize their supply chain configurations, and make data-driven decisions to improve efficiency and responsiveness.

How does LLamasoft support organizations in achieving supply chain resilience?

LLamasoft supports organizations in achieving supply chain resilience by providing advanced modeling and simulation capabilities that allow businesses to assess risks, evaluate alternative strategies, and develop contingency plans. By understanding potential disruptions and their impacts, companies can create more flexible supply chains that can quickly adapt to changing market conditions.

About Texaco
------------

Texaco was an independent company until its refining operations merged into Chevron Corporation in 2001, at which time most of its station franchises were divested to the Shell Oil Company.  
  
The company was headquartered in Harrison, New York, near White Plains, prior to the merger with Chevron.  
  
It began as the Texas Fuel Company, founded in 1901 in Beaumont, Texas. For many years, Texaco was the only company selling gasoline under the same brand name in all 50 US states, as well as Canada, making it the most truly national brand among its competitors. Its current logo features a white star in a red circle (a reference to the lone star of Texas), leading to the long-running jingles "You can trust your car to the man who wears the star" and "Star of the American Road".  
  
On Feb 8, 2002 Chevron Corporation merged with Texaco, and Shell purchased Texaco's interest in the Equilon and Motiva joint ventures, Shell began converting its Texaco stations to the Shell brand the next year. In July 2004, Chevron regained non-exclusive rights to the Texaco brand name in the US. The following year, in August, Texaco introduced the Techron additive into its fuels in the US and parts of Latin America.

Créé en 1992, Groupe Focus connaît une forte expansion depuis plusieurs années et emploie aujourd’hui plus de 140 professionnels dans ses quatre établissements au Québec.

Created in 1992, Groupe Focus has been expanding strongly for several years and now employs more than 140 professionals in its four establishments in Quebec.

About hVIVO
-----------

hVIVO plc (ticker: HVO) (formerly Open Orphan plc) is a rapidly growing specialist contract research organisation (CRO) and the world leader in testing infectious and respiratory disease vaccines and therapeutics using human challenge clinical trials. The Group provides end-to-end early clinical development services to its large, established and growing repeat client base, which includes four of the top 10 largest global biopharma companies.  
  
The Group's fast-growing services business includes a unique portfolio of 10+ human challenge models to test a broad range of infectious and respiratory disease products, world class challenge agent manufacturing, specialist drug development and clinical consultancy services via its Venn Life Sciences brand, and a lab offering via its hLAB brand, which includes virology, immunology biomarker and molecular testing. The Group offers additional clinical field trial services such as patient recruitment and clinical trial site services.  
  
hVIVO runs challenge studies in London from its Whitechapel quarantine clinic, its state-of-the-art QMB clinic with its highly specialised on-site virology and immunology laboratory, and its clinic in Plumbers Row. To recruit volunteers / patients for its studies, the Company leverages its unique clinical trial recruitment capacity via its FluCamp volunteer screening facilities in London and Manchester.

About Canadian County Government
--------------------------------

The county was organized in 1890 and consists of 897 square miles (2018). It provides a growing and diversified mix of business and industry, including agribusiness, manufacturing, oil & gas and retail trade. Plus it offers the added benefit of close proximity to the growing Oklahoma City market.  
  
Canadian County offers extensive economic development opportunities, including top-ranked schools, a productive and competitive labor force, excellent business climate and the nation's top career-technology network, Canadian Valley. Cost of living is just 80% of the national average.  
  
Major cities include El Reno (County Seat), Mustang, and Yukon. Canadian County's history is reflective of the entire state. It has been home to various Indian Tribes, the cattle industry, frontier military experience, land runs and land lotteries, various ethnic settlements, right agriculture and oil & gas production. The county was once part of the Cheyenne and Arapaho reservation. It was opened by the Run of '89 and the Run of '92, and by lottery in 1901. The historic Chisholm Trail passes through the county on the North/South basis. The trail, stretching from Texas to Kansas City is famous for the 10 million cattle, 1 million horses and 35 thousand cowboys that passed through in the 1800's.  
  
The name Canadian county comes from early French explorers who named the county for the two rivers which pass through the area, the North Canadian and Canadian.

About Orchard House Family Assessment Centre
--------------------------------------------

Orchard House is proud to be one of very few family assessment centres in the UK rated ‘Outstanding’ by Ofsted at our most recent inspection. This underlines the skill, dedication, and commitment of the staff team.  
  
For over 15 years Orchard House Family Assessment Centre has provided high-quality support to vulnerable children and families, assisting families around the clock so that we can help the Family Courts to make difficult decisions in the best interests of the child.  
  
Domestic abuse, drugs and alcohol, mental health, learning disabilities, and child abuse – many of the parents we work with have already suffered as children and adults themselves. We are committed to providing families with support and intervention that aims to break the cycle and allow parents to be the best parents that they can be.  
  
Safeguarding is at the heart of all that we do – it is our priority to ensure that children and their parents are safe and have the best possible opportunity to demonstrate their parenting whilst they are with us.  
  
Orchard House is passionate about lifelong learning – we are committed to all of our colleagues and supporting their continuing professional development.

What services does Regroup Telehealth offer?

Regroup Telehealth specializes in integrated telemental health and telepsychiatry services. They provide a comprehensive range of solutions including virtual therapy sessions, psychiatric evaluations, medication management, and ongoing mental health support. Their services are designed to cater to a variety of mental health needs, ensuring that patients receive timely and effective care from licensed behavioral health clinicians.

Who can benefit from Regroup's telehealth services?

Regroup's telehealth services are beneficial for a wide range of individuals, including those struggling with mental health issues such as anxiety, depression, PTSD, and other behavioral health conditions. Their services are also tailored for healthcare entities such as hospitals, clinics, and community health organizations looking to expand their mental health offerings and improve access to care for their patients.

How does Regroup ensure the quality of care in its telehealth services?

Regroup ensures quality care through a nationwide network of licensed and experienced behavioral health clinicians. They implement a proven process that includes rigorous clinician vetting, ongoing training, and adherence to best practices in telehealth. Additionally, Regroup utilizes secure, HIPAA-compliant technology to protect patient privacy and facilitate effective communication between clinicians and patients.

What types of mental health professionals are part of Regroup's network?

Regroup's network includes a diverse range of mental health professionals, such as psychiatrists, psychologists, licensed clinical social workers, and psychiatric nurse practitioners. This multidisciplinary approach allows Regroup to provide comprehensive care tailored to the unique needs of each patient, ensuring that they receive the appropriate level of support and treatment.

Is Regroup Telehealth available nationwide?

Yes, Regroup Telehealth operates across the United States, providing services to patients in various states. Their extensive network of clinicians allows them to reach individuals in both urban and rural areas, ensuring that mental health services are accessible to those who need them, regardless of their location.

What technology do I need to access Regroup's telehealth services?

To access Regroup's telehealth services, patients need a device with internet connectivity, such as a smartphone, tablet, or computer. Additionally, patients should have a webcam and microphone for video consultations. Regroup uses a secure, user-friendly platform that is compatible with most devices, making it easy for patients to connect with their clinicians from the comfort of their own homes.

About English PEN
-----------------

English PEN promotes literature and human rights. A registered charity, our membership is drawn from all those who work with the written word: Poets, Essayists, Novelists, academics, journalists, playwrights, publishers, booksellers, translators and literary agents. We were established in 1921 as the founding centre of an international network of PEN centres. PEN International now has a 144 centres in 102 countries.  
  
English PEN defends the rights of persecuted writers abroad, while maintaining a robust defence of free speech in the UK. We promote literature in translation through a major Arts Council funded programme, and run literacy programmes in refugee centres and prisons.

What services does Sevenstep offer in the realm of recruitment process outsourcing (RPO)?

Sevenstep specializes in various RPO services, including Project RPO, Enterprise RPO, and Blended RPO, which combines both contingent and permanent hiring solutions. Our comprehensive approach allows us to tailor our services to meet the specific needs of each client, ensuring that we can effectively manage large-scale hiring and deliver top talent efficiently.

How does Sevenstep utilize data analytics in its recruitment process?

At Sevenstep, we leverage advanced data analytics to enhance our recruitment strategies. By analyzing market trends, candidate behaviors, and hiring metrics, we provide actionable insights that help our clients make informed decisions. This data-driven approach enables us to optimize talent acquisition processes, reduce time-to-fill, and improve overall hiring outcomes.

What industries does Sevenstep support with its talent acquisition solutions?

Sevenstep supports a wide range of industries, including technology, healthcare, finance, manufacturing, and retail. Our global RPO expertise allows us to adapt our recruitment strategies to the unique challenges and demands of each sector, ensuring that we can effectively attract and retain top talent across various fields.

Can Sevenstep help with employer branding and talent attraction?

Yes, Sevenstep offers services focused on employer branding and talent attraction. We understand the importance of a strong employer brand in attracting top candidates. Our team works closely with clients to develop and promote their unique value propositions, enhancing their visibility in the job market and making them more appealing to potential hires.

What is the difference between Project RPO and Enterprise RPO offered by Sevenstep?

Project RPO is designed for specific hiring projects or initiatives, allowing clients to scale their recruitment efforts for a defined period or purpose. In contrast, Enterprise RPO is a more comprehensive solution that integrates with a client's overall recruitment strategy, providing ongoing support for all hiring needs across the organization. This flexibility allows clients to choose the solution that best fits their current hiring challenges.

How does Sevenstep ensure the quality of candidates in its recruitment process?

Sevenstep employs a rigorous candidate screening and selection process that includes in-depth assessments, interviews, and reference checks. Our team of recruiting experts utilizes industry best practices and innovative sourcing techniques to identify high-quality candidates. Additionally, we continuously monitor and evaluate our recruitment processes to ensure we maintain the highest standards of candidate quality and fit for our clients.

About Tock
----------

Tock is a comprehensive platform built to fundamentally change the way restaurants, bars, and wineries think about and run their business. This includes a robust reservation, takeout/delivery, guest, and table management system for businesses of all sizes across the globe.  
  
Tock was founded in 2014 but the idea originated years before out of a simple frustration. Nick Kokonas and Chef Grant Achatz opened Alinea to international fanfare in 2005 - now a perennial Michelin three star and widely considered one of the best restaurants in the world. For years they were spending $140,000 a year on staff dedicated to managing reservations and losing an average of $260,000 a year on cancellations. Convinced there had to be a better way, Nick started work on a crude ticketing system. The homemade platform was a success. Soon after Nick founded Tock with Brian Fitzpatrick, founder of Google's Chicago engineering office, to turn this simple idea into a robust product complete with all the tools a restaurant needs to succeed.

His mother, Pilar Bardem, is a respected Spanish actress, and his grandparents were also involved in the world of film and theater. Bardem's early exposure to the performing arts greatly influenced his decision to pursue acting as a career. He honed his craft at the Escuela de Artes y Oficios in Madrid, where he studied drama and developed his skills as a performer.  
  
Bardem made his film debut in 1990 in the Spanish drama "Las Edades de Lulú," directed by Bigas Luna. His breakout role came in 1992's "Jamon Jamon," in which he starred alongside Penélope Cruz. The film garnered critical acclaim and propelled Bardem into the spotlight, earning him widespread recognition for his raw talent and magnetic on-screen presence. His performance in "Jamon Jamon" earned him a Goya Award for Best Actor, solidifying his status as a rising star in the Spanish film industry.  
  
In the years that followed, Bardem continued to deliver compelling performances in a variety of films, establishing himself as a respected and sought-after actor. He gained international recognition for his portrayal of a terminally ill man in the 2000 film "Before Night Falls," for which he received his first Academy Award nomination for Best Actor. Bardem's ability to embody complex and emotionally charged characters set him apart as a truly exceptional talent, earning him a reputation as one of the most versatile actors of his generation.  
  
Bardem's career reached new heights with his role as the psychopathic hitman Anton Chigurh in the Coen Brothers' 2007 film "No Country for Old Men." His chilling and enigmatic performance earned him widespread acclaim and numerous accolades, including an Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor. Bardem's portrayal of Anton Chigurh solidified his status as a powerhouse performer and further solidified his place among the elite actors in the industry.

Bardem's talent extends beyond the realm of acting, as he has also ventured into producing and directing. About Pat Field

Pat Field is an iconic American costume designer known for her bold and eclectic style that has made a lasting impact on the fashion industry and popular culture. With her unique eye for color, texture, and shape, Field has become a trailblazer in the world of costume design, creating memorable and impactful looks for some of the most beloved characters in film and television.  
  
Born in New York City, Field's career in fashion began when she opened her own boutique in Greenwich Village in the 1960s. The store, which she named "House of Field," quickly gained a reputation for its avant-garde and boundary-pushing designs, attracting a diverse and devoted clientele. Field's willingness to take risks and break the rules of traditional fashion made her a standout in the industry, and she soon became a sought-after stylist for celebrities and musicians.  
  
Field's big break in costume design came when she was hired to work on the seminal television series "Sex and the City." Field's work on the show helped to define the distinctive style of each of the main characters, creating looks that were at once glamorous, edgy, and effortlessly chic. Her groundbreaking work on "Sex and the City" earned her widespread acclaim and numerous awards, including an Emmy for Outstanding Costumes for a Series in 2002.  
  
In addition to her work on "Sex and the City," Field has collaborated with some of the most renowned directors and designers in the industry, including Baz Luhrmann on "The Devil Wears Prada" and "Confessions of a Shopaholic," as well as with Sofia Coppola on "The Bling Ring." Her ability to seamlessly blend high fashion with street style has made her a go-to collaborator for directors looking to create visually striking and memorable on-screen looks.  
  
Field's influence extends beyond her work in film and television. She has also made a significant impact on the fashion industry as a whole, inspiring designers and stylists to embrace individuality and self-expression in their work. Her fearless approach to fashion has helped to redefine traditional standards of beauty and style, making her a pioneer in the movement toward greater diversity and inclusivity in the industry.  
  
In addition to her work as a costume designer, Field has also made a name for herself as a fashion consultant, trendsetter, and entrepreneur. She has lent her expertise to a variety of projects, including collaborations with major brands, appearances on fashion reality shows, and the launch of her own line of clothing and accessories. Throughout her career, Field has remained committed to pushing boundaries, challenging conventions, and celebrating the power of fashion to inspire and empower.  
  
Pat Field's impact on the world of fashion and costume design cannot be overstated. Her fearless and boundary-pushing approach to style has made her a true trailblazer in the industry, inspiring countless designers, stylists, and fashion enthusiasts around the world. From her groundbreaking work on "Sex and the City" to her continued influence on the fashion industry, Field's legacy as a visionary and icon of style will continue to resonate for years to come.

About Real Estate Matrix, LLC
-----------------------------

REAL ESTATE MATRIX, LLC is a commercial valuation and advisory firm based in Birmingham, Alabama and is one of the leading commercial valuation firms in the Southeast. Real Estate Matrix’s primary coverage area includes all of Alabama, Georgia, Tennessee, Mississippi and Florida. You can also visit our website for more information on our firm (www.realestatematrix.com).  
  
REM is extensively involved in appraisal management and review services. Our clients are able to save time and money, enhance security and auditability, and ensure regulatory compliance by employing us for the following services:  
  
Assistance with maintaining a qualified approved appraiser panel  
Ensuring proper scope of work to enable credible appraisals  
Bidding out appraisal assignments to qualified appraisers  
Engaging qualified appraisers to perform valuations on behalf of the client  
Performing Compliance/Administrative Reviews, USPAP Standard Rule (3) Technical Desk Reviews or Field Reviews  
  
Appraisal reviews performed by us or REM are either Administrative Reviews (Compliance) or full USPAP Standard 3 Technical or Field Reviews. Our detailed process elicits deficiencies in appraisal reports to ensure credible appraisals in support of financial institutions’ collateral. In addition, our valuation administration program is sure to pass the scrutiny of any bank regulatory agency in regard to appraiser independence and appraisal quality control issues – while also providing security, job status reports and performance review for each vendor via a rating system. Because of this detailed process, financial institutions throughout the United States turn to REM for commercial valuation administration services (Valuation Management-Administration).

About ServiCon Service & Consult eG

Die ServiCon Service & Consult eG ist die Dienstleistungsgesellschaft der gewerblichen Verbundgruppen und Franchise-Systeme sowie die kommerzielle Schwestergesellschaft des Verbandes DER MITTELSTANDSVERBUND - ZGV e.V. Sie ist die "Einkaufskooperation der Verbundgruppen" und bietet den in Einkaufsverbänden, Genossenschaften und Franchise-Systemen organisierten mittelständischen Unternehmen interessante Services und Rahmenverträge. Die Leistungen sind nach den Anforderungen der Zentralen und der Mitglieder unterschieden und können direkt weitergegeben werden.  
  
Zu den Leistungen der ServiCon eG gehören:  
\- Verständnis für einen verbundgruppengerechten Vertrieb und den kooperierenden Mittelstand  
\- Bedarfsgerechte Lösungen für unsere Mitglieder und deren Anschlusshäuser  
\- Eine konkrete Kostenersparnis bzw. ein konkreter Zusatznutzen (Mehrwert) in Form von Rahmenverträgen.  
\- Veranstaltungen  
\- Webinare  
\- Beratung & Betreuung

About John Cho

John Cho is a renowned American actor who has left an indelible mark on both the small and big screens. Born in Seoul, South Korea, Cho moved to the United States at the age of six and grew up in Los Angeles. With his effortless charm, natural talent, and undeniable versatility, he has become a trailblazer for Asian-American actors in Hollywood.  
  
Cho's breakthrough role came in the Harold & Kumar film series, where he portrayed Harold Lee, a stoner who embarks on hilarious and absurd adventures with his best friend. The character defied stereotypes, showcasing Cho's ability to master both comedic timing and nuanced performances. His remarkable work in these films earned him a dedicated fanbase and opened doors to new opportunities.  
  
Cho's career gained further momentum when he landed the role of Hikaru Sulu in the rebooted Star Trek films. This iconic character was originally played by the late George Takei in the original Star Trek series, making Cho's portrayal a significant moment in Asian-American representation. Through his portrayal, Cho breathed new life into Sulu, crafting a complex and relatable character who defied expectations.  
  
In addition to his comedic and action roles, Cho has also proven himself as a versatile dramatic actor. One of his most notable performances is in the critically acclaimed film, "Searching." In this groundbreaking thriller, he plays a father desperately searching for his missing daughter. The entire movie is presented as if viewed through computer screens and smartphones, a challenge that Cho deftly tackles. His raw and emotional performance anchors the film, showcasing his ability to bring depth and vulnerability to his characters.  
  
Beyond his film work, Cho has made significant contributions to television. He starred in the cult classic series "Selfie," where he played a modern-day take on George Bernard Shaw's "Pygmalion." Cho's portrayal of Henry Higgs, a self-assured marketing expert who takes on the task of transforming a social media-obsessed woman, was refreshingly dynamic. Despite the show's short run, Cho's performance was widely praised by critics who lauded his chemistry with co-star Karen Gillan.  
  
Cho's impact on the entertainment industry extends beyond his acting talent. He has actively advocated for increased Asian-American representation in Hollywood, using his platform to address systemic issues and promote diversity. In an industry marked by whitewashing and ethnic stereotypes, Cho has consistently pushed for greater opportunities for actors of Asian descent, challenging the status quo and opening doors for future generations.  
  
Outside of his professional achievements, Cho is known for his affable and down-to-earth personality. Fans and colleagues alike often remark on his humility, kindness, and positive attitude. These qualities, combined with his talent, have made him a beloved figure in the industry.  
  
In conclusion, John Cho is an incredibly talented and versatile actor who has made a lasting impact on American film and television. From his breakout role in the Harold & Kumar films to his portrayal of Sulu in the Star Trek franchise, Cho has defied stereotypes and forged new paths for Asian-American actors. His performances resonate with audiences, whether he's making them laugh, cry, or gasp in suspense. Cho's work not only showcases his remarkable acting abilities but also highlights the importance of diverse representation in the media. In addition to his on-screen achievements, Cho's commitment to advocacy and his genuine persona have solidified his place as an influential figure in the entertainment industry.

Born on July 29, 1980, in New York City, Rachel Miner began her acting career at a young age. She made her debut in the 1990 film "Alice" when she was just nine years old. Her breakthrough performance came in 1994 when she portrayed the character of Michelle Bauer Santos in the soap opera "Guiding Light." Miner received critical acclaim for her portrayal, earning a Daytime Emmy Award nomination for Outstanding Younger Actress in a Drama Series. This recognition catapulted her into the spotlight and paved the way for her future success.  
  
Miner's talent as an actress goes beyond her early achievements. Her ability to bring emotional depth and authenticity to her characters makes her a standout performer. One of her notable roles was in the film "Bully" (2001), where she played the complex and troubled character of Ali, a high school student who becomes involved in a violent plot to kill her abusive boyfriend. Miner's portrayal of Ali was raw, honest, and haunting, leaving a lasting impact on audiences.  
  
In addition to her film work, Miner has had an impressive career in television. She appeared in various popular shows, including "Law & Order: Criminal Intent," "CSI: Miami," and "Grey's Anatomy." One of her most memorable television roles came in the hit series "Supernatural." Miner played the demon Meg Masters, a recurring character known for her manipulative and cunning nature. Her portrayal of Meg earned her a dedicated fanbase and cemented her status as a talented actress in the genre.  
  
Beyond her on-screen accomplishments, Miner has also made significant contributions to the theater world. In 2005, she made her debut on Broadway in the play "The Miracle Worker," portraying Anne Sullivan. Her performance received critical acclaim, with reviewers praising her ability to capture the spirit of the character. Miner's stage work showcases her versatility as an actress and her dedication to her craft.

What services does StatusCast provide?

StatusCast offers a comprehensive status page solution that allows businesses to communicate their service status to customers in real-time. This includes incident management, uptime monitoring, and customizable status pages that can be branded to match a company's identity. Additionally, StatusCast provides integration with various third-party tools to streamline incident reporting and updates.

How does StatusCast help with incident management?

StatusCast simplifies incident management by providing a centralized platform where teams can log incidents, update statuses, and communicate with stakeholders. Users can create incident reports that detail the nature of the issue, its impact, and the steps being taken to resolve it. This transparency helps build trust with customers and reduces the volume of inquiries during outages.

What industries does StatusCast support?

StatusCast serves a wide range of industries including SaaS (Software as a Service), eCommerce, IT services, telecommunications, and finance. Any organization that relies on digital services can benefit from StatusCast's solutions to keep their customers informed about service availability and performance.

Can I customize my status page with StatusCast?

Yes, StatusCast allows users to fully customize their status pages. You can add your company logo, choose color schemes, and create custom messages to reflect your brand. This ensures that your status page not only provides essential information but also aligns with your corporate identity.

Does StatusCast offer integrations with other tools?

Absolutely! StatusCast offers integrations with a variety of third-party tools such as Slack, Microsoft Teams, and various incident management platforms. These integrations enable seamless communication and updates, allowing teams to manage incidents more effectively and keep stakeholders informed without switching between multiple applications.

Is there a trial period available for StatusCast services?

Yes, StatusCast offers a free trial period for new users. This allows potential customers to explore the features and capabilities of the platform without any commitment. About Phillip Perkins

Phillip Perkins currently serves as Vice President at Motion Recruitment, where he plays a pivotal role in shaping the recruitment landscape, particularly in the realms of artificial intelligence and machine learning. With a keen focus on driving sales and operational excellence across the Boston, Washington DC, and Atlanta regions, Phillip oversees a dynamic workforce of approximately 100 recruiters spread across 17 specialized sales teams. His leadership is characterized by a strategic approach to talent acquisition, where he leverages his extensive network and deep industry insights to connect top-tier talent with innovative companies.  
  
Phillip's expertise extends beyond traditional recruitment; he is adept at navigating the complexities of benefits negotiation and executive search, ensuring that both candidates and clients achieve optimal outcomes. His proficiency in applicant tracking systems and internet recruiting enables him to streamline the sourcing process, enhancing efficiency and effectiveness in identifying high-caliber candidates. As a seasoned professional in temporary placement and management, Phillip is committed to fostering a collaborative environment that empowers his teams to excel in their roles.  
  
Key projects under Phillip's guidance include the implementation of advanced recruitment strategies that harness data analytics to refine sourcing techniques and improve candidate engagement. His passion for mentoring emerging recruiters has not only bolstered team performance but also cultivated a culture of continuous learning and adaptation within the organization. As the recruitment landscape evolves, Phillip remains at the forefront, driving innovation and excellence in the pursuit of talent that propels businesses forward.

About Aqua Terra Water Management
---------------------------------

Our customers can rely on Aqua Terra’s management team which has over 85 years of disposal expertise so they can focus on their core business functions – oil and gas exploration and production. By partnering with producers Aqua Terra can understand our customers needs providing safe and environmentally friendly water management solutions. Aqua Terra designs and provides the state of the art facilities necessary to handle the disposal needs our customers require. Working directly with producers allows Aqua Terra to strategically locate disposals providing pipeline infrastructures and quicker truck turns ultimately saving producers money.  
  
Aqua Terra recognizes that with the rise in regulatory restrictions of waste water management it has become increasingly difficult for Producers to cost effectively handle water management internally. The combination of the capacity constrained market and inconsistent pricing, third party transport & disposal costs have continued to rise. Aqua Terra has developed a partnership model which allows Producers to know all of their water management costs upfront. This model allows our partners to have more budgetary accuracy alleviating irregularities and ensuring regulatory compliance.  
  
By implementing a joint venture partnership, Aqua Terra will work with producers to handle all of their water management needs—from forecasting volumes, to constructing facilitates, pipelining water and price setting.

In June 2009, the former Nikko Cordial Securities Inc. set up Nikko Cordial Securities De-Merger Preparatory Company Ltd., and on October 1, 2009, succeeded all of the operations (excluding selected assets and liabilities) of the former Nikko Cordial Securities Inc. and certain businesses, including the domestic debt and equity underwriting businesses, of Nikko Citigroup Limited (current Citigroup Global Markets Japan Inc.) by means of an absorption-type corporate demerger. On October 1, 2009, after succeeding such businesses, Nikko Cordial Securities De-Merger Preparatory Company Ltd. renamed itself as Nikko Cordial Securities Inc. to start as a new securities and investment banking firm, with retail and wholesale business arms.  
As of October 1, 2009, Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation acquired all the shares in the renamed Nikko Cordial Securities Inc., and through this operation, the renamed Nikko Cordial Securities Inc. became a member of Sumitomo Mitsui Financial Group.

About Cook County Department of Public Health
---------------------------------------------

CCDPH is the state certified public health agency for Cook County with the exception of Chicago, Evanston, Skokie, Oak Park and Stickney Township. These four municipalities and one township have separate, state certified, local public health departments. With more than 300 employees serving approximately 2.5 million residents in 129 municipalities, CCDPH staff strives to meet the public health needs of our suburban Cook County jurisdiction through effective and efficient disease prevention and health promotion programs.  
  
CCDPH takes a network approach to protecting and promoting health. Our staff brings people and resources together to address issues facing our communities. CCDPH provides clinical services around communicable diseases, and reproductive and oral health. We work to prevent the spread of more than 70 reportable communicable diseases and enforce Cook County and Illinois public health laws, rules and regulations.

About East Jefferson General Hospital
-------------------------------------

Opening on Valentine's Day, 1971, East Jefferson General Hospital started as a 250-bed facility with almost 250 physicians serving the newly burgeoning suburbs of Jefferson Parish. From the beginning, the hospital was to be a not-for-profit community hospital with a board of directors comprised of representatives from the community's financial, educational, civic, and business community. Today, EJGH stands as a state-of-the-art hospital with more than 420 beds. Still a community hospital with a board comprised of representatives throughout the community, our patients are served by a staff of more than 3,000 team members and more than 650 physicians.  
  
In 2002, EJGH became Louisiana's first nurse Magnet hospital for our excellence in nursing care by the American Nurses Credentialing Center. In 2012, we were certified as a Magnet facility for the third consecutive time. This credential is the highest honor an organization can receive for professional nursing practice. We have exceeded the national average in board-certified nurses for all magnet hospitals. EJGH also has 250 Specialty Board-Certified Nurses, which signifies excellence in nursing practice through experience with a specialized patient population, knowledge about evidence-based care and best practices used for treating those patients. In 2011, EJGH was the only hospital to receive the prestigious American Board of Nursing Specialties Award for Nursing Certification Advocacy.  
  
EJGH’s mission is to continue to provide the highest quality, compassionate healthcare to the people we serve. In 2013, EJGH partnered with the Planetree Organization, which is a forerunner in the patient-centered care industry. The Planetree Model creates patient-centered care within hospitals by looking at their current processes of care through the eyes of the patients and looks for ways to improve it. With their partnership, we were able to develop a higher level of personalized care from our own existing culture.

About ELIA
----------

What is ELIA?  
  
ELIA - European League of Institutes of the Arts is a globally connected European network that provides a dynamic platform for professional exchange and development in higher arts education. With over 250 members in 47 countries, it represents some 300.000 students in all art disciplines.  
  
Its cross-disciplinary quality makes ELIA unique as a network. ELIA advocates for higher arts education by empowering and creating new opportunities for its members and facilitating the exchange of good practices. ELIA collaborates with partner networks around the world.  
  
ELIA is determined to:  
  
• Strengthen the position and influence of the arts and higher arts education at regional, national, European and international levels  
• Support the establishing and maintaining of adequate social and political conditions for the free development of education in the arts and the specific needs of education in the arts and of art production.  
• Promote the arts as a central aspect of society and as a fundamental contribution to cultural and economic development;  
• Encourage cultural diversity and foster communication between European and non-European cultures as part of a global cultural society.  
  
On the ELIA website \[www.elia-artschools.org\] you can read all about ELIA’s News Updates, Projects, Events, Job Posts and various Calls.

Our bikes are some of the best TREK front suspension bikes in Myanmar, with adjustable gears, quality brakes, comfortable saddles and high quality internaitonal standard safety helmets to ensure you have a relaxed and safe experience with us.  
  
Our Chin tours are lead by trained and expereinced local guides from Chin alongside, an experienced tour leader, along with local porters and drivers to ensure we recruit from the local area we work and to ensure a smooth trip start to finish.  
  
We also manage special group charity challenges and work with international and local businesses to provide team building and charity rides.

About Shreyas Nagaraj

Shreyas Nagaraj is an accomplished Software Engineering Manager (EM - II) at Latitude AI, bringing over 15 years of comprehensive software engineering experience across various domains, including SaaS, enterprise software, and consumer technology. With more than five years in engineering leadership, Shreyas has honed his expertise in guiding high-performing teams to deliver innovative solutions in complex environments. Currently, he spearheads an engineering team dedicated to developing a suite of cloud tools and services that are pivotal in accelerating the development of Ford’s “Level-3” autonomous vehicle software stack.  
  
At Latitude AI, Shreyas is instrumental in leading key projects such as the triage tooling and services initiative. This suite of web tools is designed to empower triage analysts with the capabilities they need to efficiently manage and analyze data, ensuring the seamless operation of autonomous vehicle systems. His technical leadership is characterized by a deep understanding of software architecture, performance tuning, and data pipelines, which are critical in optimizing the functionality and reliability of these cloud-based services.

About Minnie Rose
-----------------

MINNIE ROSE: ALWAYS IN SEASON  
  
With a passion for fresh style and comfort, Minnie Rose is a leader among American luxury knitwear collections.  
  
Minnie Rose launched in 2006 with a focused mission: to offer stylish women something beyond traditional cashmere- pieces that turned heads for their fashionable look. With this purpose, we originated a line of dusters and shawls that helped make cashmere an essential in every woman’s wardrobe year-round. The brand uses the finest quality materials and craftsmanship, creating luxurious pieces you’ll want to live- all while still maintaining an affordable price point.  
  
Today, our featherweight cashmere remains at the core of Minnie Rose, which has expanded into a broader lifestyle brand, both chic and timeless. Our styles include sumptuous cotton/lycra basics, cashmere sweaters to layer, and inspired trend pieces. Each collection features a distinctive color palette that mixes neutrals with lush, saturated hues, making it wearable and versatile. Our cashmere and cottons are all dyed to match, creating an effortlessly refined look.  
  
Located in the heart of New York’s Fashion District, designer Lisa Shaller-Goldberg finds daily inspiration in America’s most vibrant city as well as her frequent travels to fashion destinations around the globe. The Minnie Rose brand resonates with the diverse lifestyles of women everywhere, creating a loyal following. It’s also regularly seen adorning celebrities and models in top entertainment and fashion magazines.  
  
Our customer never stops evolving – and neither does our commitment to quality, creativity and comfort.

He’s adept at using tools like PSpice and LabVIEW for circuit design and testing, further enhancing his ability to deliver comprehensive solutions that address complex engineering challenges. His collaborative approach and deep understanding of computer architecture and assembly language allow him to work effectively across multidisciplinary teams, driving projects from conception through to successful implementation. Tao Capital Partners primarily focuses on technology, healthcare, and consumer sectors. They seek to invest in companies that are innovating within these industries, particularly those that leverage technology to enhance their offerings. Tao Capital Partners employs a rigorous evaluation process that includes market analysis, financial modeling, and due diligence. They assess the management team, competitive landscape, and growth potential of the business. The typical investment size for Tao Capital Partners varies depending on the stage of the company and the specific opportunity. The firm tailors its investment strategy to meet the needs of each portfolio company.

They offer strategic guidance, operational support, and access to a network of industry experts and potential partners. This holistic approach is designed to help companies navigate challenges and capitalize on growth opportunities.

How can companies approach Tao Capital Partners for funding?

Companies interested in seeking funding from Tao Capital Partners can submit a business plan or pitch deck through their website. It is advisable to include detailed information about the business model, market opportunity, financial projections, and the management team. ---------------------------------------

The Cloud Native Computing Foundation is currently being formed. Its members are committed to creating an open governance structure and open source projects that will advance modern distributed applications and cloud application management. They will also strive to make the technology ubiquitous and easily available, and to foster a vibrant ecosystem of organizations that are adopting a contemporary approach to applications. The Cloud Native Computing Foundation will be established as a Collaborative Project within the organizational structure of The Linux Foundation. The Cloud Native Computing Foundation will include a Technical Oversight Committee and an End User Advisory Board to ensure alignment of user needs with the technical community, as well as a Governing Board.

Nestled in the hills of north San Diego County, Altman Plants is home to over 1,025 unique varieties of cacti and succulents. Their nurturing care and passion for each individual plant set them apart and quickly grew the business to the industry front-runner it is today. Since those humble beginnings, with the help of a team of renowned plant breeders and dedicated staff, Altman Plants is now one of the largest nurseries in the country and the largest succulent grower in the world. We strive to provide high-quality living treasures, for collectors and retailers alike.

About BASElayer
---------------

While companies like Square and PayPal process millions of digital payments, they are limited in the currencies and assets they support. If you owned shares of stock in Google for example, you could not use them to purchase a cup of coffee at your local coffee shop. In a world where nearly every asset—currencies, commodities, and even in-game credits—is traded digitally, it makes no sense that they not be interoperable.  
BASElayer is pioneering this effort. Its expansive network facilitates direct payment between different asset classes, allows for rules and behaviors to be directly programed into any asset, and supports easy integration of legacy financial systems. However, unlike its counterparts, BASElayer is a completely open development platform designed to help developers create and deploy financial applications.

About Nik Robinson

Nik Robinson, the visionary CEO of Big Time Gaming, has made an indelible mark on the online gaming industry, particularly through his groundbreaking inventions of Grid Slots and the revolutionary Megaways™ mechanic. With a rich background that spans over two decades, Nik's journey began as the founder and Managing Director of NT Media in 1997, where he was instrumental in pioneering non-download gaming products that transformed the landscape of online casinos. His leadership at NT Media culminated in a merger with Orbis, leading to the creation of Openbet, which was later acquired by Scientific Games, further solidifying his reputation as a leader in gaming innovation.  
  
In his current role at Big Time Gaming, Nik is at the forefront of driving innovation in game design and development. His expertise in online gaming, casino mechanics, and mobile applications allows him to spearhead key projects that push the boundaries of player engagement and experience. Under his guidance, Big Time Gaming has launched a series of successful titles that leverage cutting-edge technology and gameplay mechanics, appealing to a diverse audience of players. Nik's deep understanding of social games and video game dynamics informs his strategic vision, ensuring that the company remains a leader in the competitive gaming market.  
  
Nik's commitment to innovation is not just about creating new games; it’s about redefining how players interact with gaming products. His proficiency in ActionScript and gameplay design enables him to lead teams in developing immersive experiences that resonate with users. As he continues to shape the future of online gaming, Nik Robinson remains a pivotal figure in the industry, dedicated to enhancing the player experience through creativity and technological advancement.

About Hospital Albert Einstein
------------------------------

O nascimento da Sociedade Beneficente Israelita Brasileira Albert Einstein, na década de 50, resultou do compromisso da comunidade judaica em oferecer à população brasileira uma referência em qualidade da prática médica.  
  
Mas a Sociedade queria ir além da simples construção de um hospital. E assim foi feito, construído com recursos provenientes de doações e do trabalho de um grupo de pessoas dedicadas, o Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein foi inaugurado em 1971.  
  
A partir de então, tornou-se referência em tratamentos com tecnologia de ponta, atendimento humanizado e expandiu suas fronteiras com ações de responsabilidade social e atividades de ensino e pesquisa.  
  
Hoje, a Sociedade Beneficente Israelita Brasileira Albert Einstein está à frente de projetos importantes, que mostram como a parceria público-privada pode render frutos para a comunidade.  
  
Abrigadas no Instituto Israelita de Ensino e Pesquisa Albert Einstein, as atividades de educação e pesquisa são o motor de inovação que não se restringem aos pacientes do Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein e englobam cursos técnicos, de graduação e de pós-graduação, treinamentos sofisticados e pesquisas clínica e experimental.  
  
O Einstein é hoje um sistema de saúde. Nossas sementes se espalham em diversas frentes e endereços, multiplicando frutos em benefício dos pacientes, da sociedade e do Sistema Público de Saúde.

What makes us different?  
  
Our team consists of a number of multicultural technology experts with experience of either studying or working within Higher Education. Many of our staff have experienced student mobility first hand. Born from within the industry we have a good understanding of our market and continually engage with clients through our uservoice service and via community events, to develop the product and support clients in line with the needs of this sector into the future.  
  
We currently provide online solutions to support mobility management, international relationship management and recruitment, application and admissions management. We are passionate about giving students international experiences to help broaden minds and provide more opportunity within their personal life, contributing to academic achievement and employment, allowing students to reach their potential.  
  
We believe our technology can help enable global potential.

About 6SensorLabs
-----------------

6SensorLabs is now Nima!  
  
We are developing breakthrough consumer products, starting with Nima, enabling you to know what is in your food. We believe meal time should be about the enjoyment of your food and your company, and not the worry about the potential repercussions of eating something unknown. We exist for you to eat with confidence and stay healthy! For us, it's personal. We're on a mission to change the dining experience, forever.  
  
Our Mission  
  
A huge part of our lives center around food and mealtime, and at 6SensorLabs, we believe food and identity are intertwined. However, we don’t know what’s in our food. Our founders long struggled with food allergies and sensitivities and were tired of always getting sick and worrying if food was safe to eat. After meeting at MIT, they built a technology company to alleviate the stress around hidden food ingredients, deliver social freedom and make mealtime enjoyable again. We’re backed by the most prestigious hardware VCs, including Upfront Ventures, SoftTech VC, SK Ventures, Mitch Kapor and Lemnos Labs.  
  
Our first product is Nima, a discreet and portable sensor that allows consumers to test their food for unwanted ingredients anywhere, anytime. Nima will offer a community experience with the ability to share food test results with other users via a connected app. Our technology takes a whole new approach to food testing through an innovative blend of chemistry and engineering. Our innovation has applications beyond food sensitivities, with the potential to assist laboratory testing across industries. Nima was named winner of TechCrunch Hardware Battlefield CES 2016 and one of TIME magazine’s “Best Inventions of 2015.”

About Walerud Ventures
----------------------

Not currently investing. Walerud Ventures joins pre-seed and seed stage companies as investors, advisors and part-time employees. Our focus sectors are high tech, deep tech, and impact tech.  
  
IN THE TRENCHES  
We join at the very early stages, often from just an idea and a couple of people. We spend a day a week with you to help set up the early team, strategy and sales. We'll join you in packing boxes, (wo)man the booth at trade shows, and as CxO as necessary. Since we work so closely with our startups we only take on a few at a time. Therefore, we make sure to select projects that make our hearts sing.  
  
LONG & CURRENT EXPERIENCE  
Of the 18 companies we have been heavily involved in, four have become world class successes (Klarna, Tobii, Lensway, Bluetail) and another ten had good and profitable exits or are growing nicely. We've also coached hundreds of startups and work very hard to make our startups successful. Our annual return on investment since 2002 exceeds 60%.  
  
PAYING IT FORWARD  
Walerud Ventures is dedicated to building Sweden and its startup and tech ecosystem. We work closely with incubators around the country, the Royal Academy of Sciences (IVA), Prince Daniel's Fellowship, and Geek Girl Meetup. We also work on policy with the Swedish government: Jane is part of the The Swedish Government Innovation Council chaired by the Prime Minister, and Caroline is part of Entreprenörskapsutredningen reporting to the Interior Minister.  
  
Read more on our website www.walerud.com

About Detroit Zoological Society
--------------------------------

The Detroit Zoological Society (DZS) is a nonprofit organization that operates the Detroit Zoo in Royal Oak, Mich. and the Belle Isle Nature Center, located in Detroit.  
  
Accredited by the Association of Zoos & Aquariums, DZS employs approximately 350 full and part-time employees and hosts more than 500 volunteers throughout the year.  
  
The 125-acre Detroit Zoo is a natural habitat for more than 2,000 animals. Major exhibits include the National Amphibian Conservation Center, Polk Penguin Conservation Center, Deveraux Tiger Forest, Great Apes of Harambee and Arctic Ring of Life, voted the number-two zoo exhibit in the U.S. by the Intrepid Traveler’s guide to “America’s Best Zoos”.  
  
The Belle Isle Nature Center, nestled on 6 acres of Michigan's forested wetland on the northeastern tip of Belle Isle State Park, offers guests unique educational, environmental and natural experiences that help connect them with urban nature. Admission to the Belle Isle Nature Center is free of charge.

How can PSW assist my organization with government relations?

PSW provides expert guidance in navigating the complexities of government relations. This includes continuous monitoring of device behavior, anomaly detection to identify unusual patterns, and threat intelligence to stay ahead of emerging vulnerabilities. By securing the entire lifecycle of IoT devices—from development to deployment—Firedome helps organizations mitigate risks associated with third-party components and ensure the integrity of their supply chains.

Can Firedome's solutions be integrated with existing IoT platforms?

Yes, Firedome's solutions are designed to be compatible with a wide range of existing IoT platforms. The integration process is streamlined to ensure minimal disruption to your current operations. Firedome provides APIs and SDKs that allow IoT vendors to easily incorporate their security features into their devices, enhancing the overall security posture without requiring extensive modifications to existing systems.

What industries can benefit from Firedome's IoT security solutions?

Firedome's IoT security solutions are applicable across various industries, including healthcare, manufacturing, smart home technology, automotive, and more. Any sector that relies on connected devices can benefit from enhanced security measures to protect sensitive data and ensure the safety of their operations. By addressing the unique challenges faced by different industries, Firedome helps organizations maintain compliance and build trust with their customers.

What are the key features of Firedome's endpoint protection for IoT?

Firedome's endpoint protection for IoT includes several key features: real-time threat detection, automated incident response, behavioral analytics, device profiling, and vulnerability management. These features work together to provide comprehensive security for connected devices, enabling organizations to quickly identify and respond to threats while maintaining operational efficiency.

How does Firedome ensure compliance with cybersecurity regulations?

Firedome is committed to helping organizations comply with various cybersecurity regulations and standards, such as GDPR, HIPAA, and NIST. Their solutions are designed to provide the necessary security controls and reporting capabilities to meet compliance requirements. Additionally, Firedome offers guidance and best practices to help organizations implement effective security measures that align with regulatory expectations.

His expertise in image processing, system design, and embedded systems plays a crucial role in refining the performance and reliability of these advanced imaging systems. Frank’s commitment to test automation and high-voltage system architecture ensures that Ionpath’s products meet the rigorous demands of the semiconductor equipment industry while maintaining the highest standards of quality and efficiency.  
  
As the company capitalizes on its recent funding success, Frank is focused on scaling engineering operations and fostering a culture of innovation within his team. His experience in team leadership and test engineering not only empowers his colleagues but also cultivates an environment where creativity and technical excellence thrive. With a keen eye on the future, Frank Tucker is dedicated to positioning Ionpath at the forefront of the rapidly evolving spatial proteomics landscape, ultimately contributing to transformative advancements in healthcare and disease research.

About Michelle Eischeid, CFA

Michelle Eischeid, CFA, serves as the Senior Vice President of Commercial Finance and Deputy CFO at Planet, where she leverages her extensive experience in finance and commercial leadership to drive strategic initiatives and enhance operational efficiencies. With a robust background that spans start-ups to multinational corporations, particularly in the fintech sector, Michelle brings a unique perspective to her role. She oversees critical functions such as Central Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A), Finance Strategy, and Investor Relations, ensuring that Planet's financial health aligns with its ambitious growth objectives.  
  
In her current position, Michelle is instrumental in managing complex areas including pricing strategies, FX settlement risk, capital expenditure, and product investment. Her expertise in bid pricing and equity valuation enables her to provide actionable insights that not only streamline operations but also optimize profitability. Additionally, Michelle plays a key role in procurement and M&A integration, where her skills in financial reporting and cash flow forecasting are vital for assessing potential acquisitions and ensuring seamless transitions.  
  
Michelle’s energetic and results-oriented approach fosters strong partnerships with leadership, allowing her to deliver data-driven recommendations that propel business objectives forward. Her proficiency in healthcare information technology and real estate financing further enhances her ability to navigate diverse sectors, making her a valuable asset to Planet as it continues to innovate and expand in the competitive fintech landscape. With a commitment to excellence and a strategic mindset, Michelle Eischeid is dedicated to driving Planet’s financial success and long-term sustainability.

About Hôpitaux Civils de Colmar
-------------------------------

Les Hôpitaux Civils de Colmar sont un Établissement Public de Santé (EPS), composé de 3 sites distincts géographiquement sur la partie ouest de la ville de Colmar : - L'Hôpital Pasteur (établissement principal), 39 avenue de la Liberté, - Le Parc, Pôle Femme, Mère Enfant, 46 rue du Stauffen, - Le Centre pour Personnes Agées (CPA), 122 rue du Logelbach. Cet ensemble est considéré comme un des quatre établissements de référence au niveau régional avec les Hôpitaux Universitaire de Strasbourg, le Centre Hospitalier de Mulhouse et le Centre Hospitalier d'Haguenau. D'une capacité de 1400 lits et places, l'établissement compte plus de 3600 agents au service de la population. La majorité des patients traités aux HCC est d’origine régionale (Colmar, Mulhouse, Strasbourg, Haguenau). 4% des patients traités sont extérieurs à la région. L'établissement a réalisé 57170 séjours hors séances en 2013.

About ClassWish.org
-------------------

ClassWish, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization, addresses devastating shortage of books, computers, art supplies, musical instruments, science equipment, sports equipment, and other resources in K-12 schools.  
  
Teachers, administrators and PTA/PTO leaders visit ClassWish.org to create Wish Lists of the things their students need.  
  
Parents, alumni, neighbors, churches, local businesses and others see exactly what is needed and make tax-deductible contributions to help.  
  
Many businesses match employees' donations, which can double their funding.  
  
ClassWish has the items shipped directly to the schools at no cost.  
  
Please visit our website at http://ClassWish.org or see our internship opportunities at http://ClassWish-Intern-Postings.org.

About Africa Capital Group LLC
------------------------------

Our mission is simple and clear: to provide our clients a focused, transparent and cost-effective means to access the tremendous growth opportunities on the continent of Africa.  
  
Africa may be the last great ground-floor international investment opportunity left on earth. Until just recently, however, the continent has remained beyond the consciousness of all but the most adventurous of investors. But now Africa is beginning to gain a wider audience in financial circles. Why? Because it has notched strong growth for the last decade and is likely still in the early stages of a powerful and transforming spurt of economic progress.  
  
Today the continent—sub-Saharan Africa in particular—features rapid growth, abundant natural resources and a large, young and increasingly educated workforce.We employ a bottom-up company-by-company approach to portfolio construction, taking into account such factors as competitive advantage, growth rate, valuation, profitability, management skill and accessibility, currency risk and political risk. We focus primarily on sub-Saharan Africa, where we believe the best opportunities are located.  
  
We offer an Africa-focused investment fund open to accredited investors. Please see our website for more information: www.africacapitalgroup.com

About RecoverWell
-----------------

RecoverWell software helps medical, legal and social service professionals streamline access to rehabilitation and recovery options for clients suffering with chemical dependencies. RecoverWell is free for patient advocates, offers HIPAA compliance to safeguard patient advocate's liability and requires no software implementation. Researching treatment centers online and calling rehabs to find availability is a huge administrative burden for patient advocates. Recoverwell's patient matching algorithm expertly identifies facilities that meet the patient's specific treatment criteria, verifies private and public insurance benefits and identifies facilities within their budget if they are not insured. Patient advocates can book their patient's treatment online without ever picking up the phone. RecoverWell verifies rehab credentials as well as those of the employed clinicians at each facility along with providing program details and photos for every facility match. Patient advocates can book treatment for their clients with confidence quickly and efficiently which minimizes a patient's opportunity to change their mind about recovery.

About Ryan Dodds

Ryan Dodds is a seasoned Director of Product Management at Stax Payments, a rapidly growing unicorn in the fintech sector. With a robust background in product leadership, Ryan oversees three dynamic squads focused on direct-to-merchant web solutions, mobile applications, and onboarding/risk management. His strategic vision and hands-on approach have been instrumental in tripling the company’s valuation since his arrival. Under his guidance, the teams have successfully launched a suite of innovative features, including early access for product-led growth (PLG), auto-verification processes, payment links, and advanced customer management tools. These enhancements have not only elevated the user experience but have also significantly improved key performance metrics such as Net Promoter Score (NPS), customer lifetime value (LTV), and overall processing volume.  
  
Ryan’s expertise is rooted in his diverse experiences, from founding startups to serving as the first product manager at both Sparkcentral and iMatchative, which were later acquired by Hootsuite and Addepar, respectively. His collaborative leadership style fosters cross-functional teamwork, ensuring that product development aligns with broader business strategies and customer insights. Additionally, Ryan’s background as a product management consultant with Dan Olsen, author of "The Lean Product Playbook," equips him with a deep understanding of agile methodologies and performance metrics. With an MBA from Rollins and a passion for mentoring, Ryan is dedicated to recruiting and nurturing top talent, driving strategic partnerships, and enhancing enterprise software solutions that meet the evolving needs of the payments landscape. As a father and industry leader, Ryan embodies a commitment to innovation and excellence in fintech.

About Us  
The company was founded in 1876 by Albert Goodwill Spalding who was a former professional baseball player and sports enthusiast. Today, Spalding is a well-known and reputable brand that specializes in manufacturing basketball, volleyball, and gymnasium equipment. With our rich history spanning over a century, Spalding has become a trusted brand in the sporting goods industry due to high-quality products and commitment to innovation.  
  
What We Do  
Spalding is the Official Basketball Equipment Supplier to the NCAA Final Four and NBA. Aside from basketball, we offer a comprehensive range of equipment for volleyball and gymnasiums. Our full product line includes portable basketball units, ceiling suspended basketball units, backboards, nets, rims, various volleyball systems and volleyball accessories, referee platforms, divider curtains, batting cages, wall padding and other gymnasium accessories.  
  
Team Spalding  
Spalding continues to be a leading provider of high-quality sporting goods and services. Our team’s excellence and passion for sports make us a go-to choice for sports enthusiasts, and athletes of all ages and levels. #MadeForTheGame
